en:
What then is the meaning of the pillar of fire? We
need the fire in the night, when it is dark. But the meaning is
the same as that of the cloud. The cloud is the fire, and the
fire is the cloud. When the sun shines, the Lord’s presence
takes the appearance of a cloud; when darkness comes,
it takes the appearance of fire. It is the same entity with
different appearances. Then what does the fire represent?
It represents the Word. The cloud is the Spirit, and the fire is
the Word. When the sun is shining, you are very clear in the
Spirit; you can easily follow the cloud. But many times it
is just like night and you are in darkness. You cannot trust
your spirit; your spirit is very much perplexed. In such a
situation, you must trust the Word. The Word is like the
fire, burning, shining, and enlightening. Psalm 119:105
says, “Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my
path.” When the sky is so clear and everything is so bright,
the cloud is adequate. But when darkness veils the sky,

en: Thematterweneedtoattendtoisthis:onlythatwhichis out of Christ can be of any value and spiritual use in the church. God never uses the old creation to construct the new creation. Neither does God use that which is of man to con- struct that which is of God. He can never, never use fleshly things to produce something spiritual. The Lord Jesus said, “That which is born of the Spirit is spirit”(John 3:6b).Would it be possible for that which is born of the flesh to become spirit? No! “That which is born of the flesh is flesh.”

en: Brothers and sisters, have youseen this? The reason that God renews our heart and gives us a new heart at the time of our regeneration is that He wants us to incline toward Him, adore Him,desire Him,and love Him.Before,we did not love Him and we could not love Him, because our heart was old and hard. Now He has renewed, softened, and turned our heart; thus, we are both able and willing to love Him. Since our heart by being renewed has become a new heart, it now has a new function. This new function is that it can incline toward God and love God and the things of God.

en: PRESS STUDY TOUR TO ANDAMAN & NICOBAR ISLAND A twelve-member Press Study Tour team to Andaman & Nicobar Island, led by Pi Lallianpuii, Director, Information & Public Relations department departed Aizawl today. en: Internal Debts: A sum of ₹ 2,429.00 crore is estimated to be received from Internal Debts of the State.Internal Debts include various loans such as Market Loans which is projected at ₹ 900.00 crore, NABARD Loan is kept at ₹ 170.00 crore, National Co-operative Development Corporation Loan capped at ₹ 5.00 crore, Rural Electricity Corporation at ₹ 2.00 crore, Power Financing Corporation loan estimated at ₹ 2.00 crore and SIDBI loan of ₹ 350.00 crore.The Government vows to continue rural infrastructure development works through NABARD loans.Some of the major projects approved for funding under NABARD RIDF XXVII are Construction of CHCs, PHCs etc. & for Infrastructure and Logistic Supplies for Fighting the Ongoing Covid Pandemic with a total project outlay of ₹ 27.25 crore, Upgradation of Existing 17.9 km Road to Cement Concrete Pavement from Meidum - Hortoki (Phase-II) with a project amount of ₹ 133.66 crore, Construction of Separate 11kV Feeders for Power Supply to Agricultural Lands amounting to ₹ 12.25 crore, Soil Conservation Measures for Enhancement of Productivity in Mizoram with a total project cost of ₹ 10.00 crore and Six Irrigation Projects in Mizoram with a project amount of ₹ 10.47 crore. en: HON'BLE UNION MINISTER SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA MEETS MAMIT DISTRICT OFFICIALS AND BENEFICIARIES. 83/2022-2023 Mamit 13th June, 2022: Shri PARSHOTTAM Rupala, Hon'ble Union Cabinet Minister, Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying today held a meeting with a District Officials and Beneficiaries of various centrally sponsor schemes at the conference hall of DC Mamit. The meeting was chaired by Pu Lalnunhlua DC Mamit. The Minister was appraised about the aspirational District programme undertakings and the present status in the delta ranking through power point presentation by Pu Lalsanglura, Nodal Officer of Aspirational District. Hon'ble Union Minister mentioned his purpose for his visited of the District and interaction with the Beneficiaries of various scheme. He assured full support for the proper implementation of the schemes so that the beneficiaries can enjoy the benefits as intended by the Government. In the meeting the Minister Interacted with the officials and beneficiaries of the following Central Scheme: AYUSHMAN BHARAT Health & Wellness, Ayushman Bharat Jan Arogya Yojana, e- Transaction, Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), PM Street Vendor's Atma Nirbhar nidhi ( PM-Svanidhi), Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana ( Gramin/Urban), Jal Jeevan Mission ( Individual household connection & Schools), Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban/Gramin), PMMVY and PM-Kisan. Union minister is accompanied by the Director, Fisheries Department, Government of Mizoram and other Officials from Aizawl. Attachment Loading attachment...
mz: MAMIT-AH UNION MINISTER SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA-IN MEETING NEIHPUI 882/2022-2023 Mamit 13th June, 2022 : Shri Parshottam Rupala, Hon'ble Union Cabinet Minister, Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Govt' of India chuan vawiin khan DC Conference Hall, Mamit-ah Mamit khawpui chhunga Sorkar Officials te leh Central Schemes hrang hranga beneficiaries te kawmna a nei. Vawiin thutkhawm Pu Lalnunhlua, District Bawrhsap kaihhruaiah hian Aspirational District Programme hnuaia hmalakna hrang hrangte Pu Lalsanglura, Aspirational District Programme Nodal Officer chuan Power point presentation hmangin chipchiar takin a tarlang a. Hmasawnna awmte leh hmachhawp/tanlakna tur hrang hrangte sawiho zui nghal a ni. Shri Parshottam Rupala, Union Minister chuan Mamit District a rawn tlawh chhan leh inkawmhona neih anih chhan sawiin Central Schemes hrang hrang District mipuite'n an hlawhtlinpui theih nan leh tha taka kalpui anih leh nih loh thlithlai a, harsatna awm angte hrechianga sutkianpui tura lokal anih thu a sawi a. District Concern Officers te pawhin Sorkar hmalakna Programme hrang hrang zirchiang a, beneficiaries te'n an hlawhtlinpui ngei theih nana tan la turin a fuih. Mamit District chu Aspirational District anih angin natna khirhkhan bik inenkawlna atan cheng Nuai 5 thleng bill theih turin ruahmanna Central-in a siam a, Mamit District chhungah mi sing 5 thlanchhuah atanga sing 3 te chu dawng tura thlanchhuah an nih tawh thu sawiin, a bak sing 2 pawh hian an hmuh theih nan hmalakpui mek an nih thu a sawi bawk. en: DEO LAWNGTLAI PUBLISHES DRAFT ELECTORAL ROLL 2020 District Election Officer (DEO), Lawngtlai Pi Shashanka Ala, IAS published a draft electoral roll 2020 of three assembly constituencies within Lawngtlai District tomorow at her office chamber and handed over the draft electoral rolls to representatives of the political parties. As per the draft electoral roll, there are 31372 voters (15852 males and 15520 females) in 36-Tuichawng (ST) A/C, 26926 voters (13524 males and 13402 females) in 37-Lawngtlai West (ST) A/C and 24000 voters (11626 males and 12374 females) in 38-Lawngtlai East (ST) A/C. In total, there are 82298 voters (41002 males and 41296 females) in Lawngtlai District. Claims and objections regarding the draft roll can be filed upto 15th January, 2020. The qualifying date for the roll is 1st January, 2020. Final electoral roll is scheduled to be published on 7th February, 2020. Meanwhile, 8 new polling stations in addition to the existing 62 stations in Tuichawng Constituency, 1 new polling station in addition to the existing 68 stations in Lawngtlai West Constituency and 7 new polling stations in addition to the existing 35 stations in Lawngtlai East Constituency are created resulting to the total number of 181 polling stations in Lawngtlai District. mz: LAWNGTLAIAH DRAFT ELECTORAL ROLL 2020 TLANGZARH A NI Kum 2020 atana Lawngtlai District-a Assembly bial pathuma draft electoral roll chu Nimin (16.12.2019) khan Lawngtlai District Election Officer, Lawngtlai Bawrhsap ni bawk Pi Shashanka Ala, IAS chuan a office chamber-ah a tlangzarh a. Draft roll hi political party ai awhte hnenah a hlan nghal. Draft electoral roll tlangzarh tak atanga a lan danin, 36-Tuichawng (ST) A/C bialah vote nei mipa 15852 leh hmeichhia 15520, an vaiin mi 31372 an awm a; 37-Lawngtlai West (ST) A/C bialah vote nei mipa 13524 leh hmeichhia 13402, an vaiin mi 26926 an awm a; 38-Lawngtlai East (ST) A/C bialah voter mipa 11626 leh hmeichhia 12374, an vaiin mi 24000 an awm a; assembly bial pathumah hian vote nei mipa 41002 leh hmeichhia 41296, an vaiin mi 82298 an awm a ni. Summary revision neih turah hian sawi duh neite tan kum thar January ni 15 thleng hun hawn a ni a. February ni 7, 2020-ah final electoral roll chu tar chhuah tura tih a ni. Hemi rual hian Tuichawng biala polling station 62 awm saah a thar 8 hawn belh niin, polling station 70 a awm tawh dawn a; Lawngtlai West-a polling station awm sa 68-ah a thar 1 hawn belh niin, polling station 69 a awm tawh ang a; Lawngtlai East-a polling station awm sa 35 baka a thar hawn belh 7 nen polling station 42 awm tawhin, Lawngtlai District chhunga bial pathumah hian a vaiin polling station 181 a awm tawh dawn a ni. en:
The other two places which speak of the inward knowledge
are John 17:3 and Ephesians 1:17. John 17:3 says that those
who have the eternal life of God are those who know God.
This means that God’s life within can cause us to know Him.
Ephesians 1:17 says that God gives us the spirit of wisdom
and revelation so that we may know Him. The spirit men-
tioned here is our human spirit related to the Spirit of God.
This means that our spirit with the spirit of God can cause us
to know God from within.

Not long after I was released from prison, I became
seriously ill with tuberculosis. I was confined to bed for six
months of absolute rest, followed by two and a half years
of greatly restricted activity for recovery. Outwardly speak-
ing, those days were really dark. But, I tell you, whenever
I prayed I felt that I was not in bed. but in the heavens.
Though I was gravely ill, yet when I prayed I had the sense
that I was not in illness, but far above it all in the heavens.
You do not know what kind of pleasure I had in the Lord
in those days. Imprisonment and persecution, then poverty
and illness. But, praise the Lord, the ascended Christ was
my way! The transcendent Christ was my way to the
heavens.

en: AGRI-MARKETING & TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDING INAUGURATED AT LUNGLEI No.523/2021-2022 Aizawl, the 28th February 2022 : Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana on Saturday (26th February, 2022) inaugurated Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building at Electric Veng, Lunglei. The Rs. 1082.93 lakhs project is implemented under the NABARD, RIDF XXIII. Lunglei HPC Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng was the guest of honour at the inauguration. At the inaugural function chaired by Commerce & Industries Department Commissioner & Secretary, Pi Esther Lal Ruatkimi, Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana commended C&I Department staff, Electric veng YMA, VCs for their contribution towards successful completion of the project. As per Technical Report presented by AIE Constructions, Tuikhuahtlang, Aizawl, the 5 floors Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building has a plinth area of 574.875 Square metres. The first floor is intended to be used as a training and awareness centre for agriculture marketing with an estimated capacity of 300 people, with guest rooms, conference/meeting rooms at the Ground floor. Basement I and Basement II contain the market areas and market offices, with a parking area at the basement.
mz: COMMERCE & INDUSTRIES MINISTER-IN LUNGLEIAH AGRI-MARKETING & TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE BUILDING HAWNG No.4122/2021-2022 Aizawl, the 26 th February 2022 : Commerce & Industries (C&I) Minister Dr R Lalthangliana chuan vawiin khan Electric Veng, Lungleiah NABARD sum cheng nuai 1082.93 senga ruahman Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building a hawng. Hawnna inkhawm Commerce & Industries Department Commissioner & Secretary, Pi Esther Lal Ruatkimi kaihhruaiah Dr R Lalthangliana chuan Lunglei khawpui chhunga hmasawnna ruhrel liantham, khawtlang tana chhenfakawm tak leh eizawnna kawnga tangkai taka hman theih tur Agri-Marketing & Training Infrastructure Building zawhfel a ni chu lawmawm tiin a buaipuitu Commerce & Industries thawktute, building sa tu te leh Electric Veng Lunglei khawtlang te chungah lawmthu a sawi a. C&I Department hnuaiah hmalakna hrang hrang kalpui mek zel anih thu sawiin Lunglei Supermarket sakna tur cheng nuai 1400 NEC atanga sanction hmuh anih thu sawiin Bangladesh ram nena kan insumdawn tawnna atana ruahman Integrated Check Post (ICP), Kawrpuichhuah, Tlabung ti hlawhtling turin Department chuan theihtawp a chhuah mek zel thu a sawi a ni. A Department chan dangte hnuaia hmalaknte pawh sawilangin Minister chuan MZU Southern Campus atan DPR cheng vaibelchhe 400 sawrkar laipuiah thehluh tawh niin chak taka bawhzui mek a ni a, MZU Southern Campus tana hman lailawk tur Engineering College building chei that hna pawh thawh mek a ni, a ti a. Civil Hospital Lungleia Trauma Centre sak pawh zawh fel thuai beisei anih thu sawiin Multipurpose Laboratory Building, NEC sum cheng nuai 300 a ruahman mek pawh nakum kum tir lama zawhfel beisei anih thu a sawi. Lunglei Municipal Council (LMC) chungchang pawh sawiin Minister chuan Municipal body chak tak enkawlna hnuaiah Lunglei khawpui chuan kawng hrang hrangin hmasawnna a nei dawn a ni, a ti. en: MIZORAM RAJYA SABHA M.P CALLS FOR CENTRAL GOVERNMENTâ€™S INTERVENTION FOR RESTORATION OF PEACE IN MYANMAR. No.612/2020-2021 Aizawl, 15th March,2021 : Mizoram Rajya Sabha M.P K.Vanlalvena called on Shri Venkaiah Naidu, Chairman, Rajya Sabha and Vice President of India today at his official residence and calls for the central governmentâ€™s intervention for restoration of peace in the trouble torn Myanmar, and to provide relief measures for Myanmar nationals who crossed international border to take shelter in Mizoram following gross atrocities committed against protesters who stand up for democracy, human rights and justice since the military junta took control of the Myanmar government. During his meeting with the Vice President, Vanlalvena was accompanied by MNF party Adviser Rosangzuala. Both raised their concern that situation in Myanmar could go from bad to worse. While many protesters have lost their lives and many more suffer injuries, a large number of protesters are arbitrarily arrested and detained. In view of the grim situation, Vanlalvena urged the central government to stand up for the people of Myanmar and review its foreign policy towards Myanmar and try to find solution for the restoration of peace and harmony in the country. While raising internatioanl issues, Vanlalvena also asked the Vice Prsident to take necessary measures for induction of a member from Mizo community in the Union Public Service Commission and to create a separate cadre for Mizoram in All India Civl Service saying, 35 years since statehood is a period long enough for Mizoram to share the AGMUT cadre. He also raised the need to open an examination centre in Aizawl for Staff Selection Commission. Attachment Loading attachment...

Heng Myanmar atanga raltlan lo lutte chhawmdawlna tur ngaihtuah a tul thu pawh thlenin Myanmar mipuite chunga tawrhna titawp tura a tul dan anga hma la turin India Vice President chu an ngen a. Myanmar laka sawrkar laipui policy chu ennawn tula an hriat thu an thlen bawk a ni. Pu Vena leh Pu Rosangzuala te chuan India independent hnuah Union Public Service Commission member ah Mizoram mi pakhat mah an la awm ngai loh avangin UPSC ah Mizo dah ve tura hma lak pui turin Vice President chu an ngen a. Team tin hian Team Leader neiin Covid-19 laka invenna chungchanga inkaihhruaina chu zau zawka mipuite hnena hrilhhriain inkaihhruaina zawmlo te chu ngaihnatthiamna tello in pawisa an chawi tir ang. Covid-19 Executive Duty-te hian The Mizoram (Containment and Prevention of Spread of Covid-19) Act, 2020 in mipuite zawm tura a duan leh sawrkar thupek chhuahte khauh takin an kengkawha, dan bawchhia mante chungah hremna lekkawh niin, challan felfai tak siamin pawisa chawi tur bituk zat an chawi tir zel a ni. Lunglei District chu bial pariat (8) ah then niin bial pakhat theuh vil turin Executive Magistrate/Incident Commander ruat fel an ni bawk. Vawiin atang khan veng tin VLTF-te nen tangkawpin Lunglei District chhungah Covid-19 Executive Duty hi neih tan a ni. Covid-19 No Tolerance Fortnight chhung hian Covid-19 hrileng chungchang hriattur hrang hrang mipuite hriattir nawnna Talkshow Local Cable kaltlanga buatsaih a ni ang. Lunglei khawpui chhung hmun lun lai ah Covid-19 laka invenn achungchang banner tar chhuah a ni bawk. en: When we want to determine a believer’s condition in life, wecannotgobywhathemanifestsoutwardly;wemustsense the savor and the element in what he manifests. en: a) Post Devolution Revenue Deficit Grants: Revenue Deficit Grants are released as monthly installments to 17 States as per the recommendations of the Fifteenth Finance Commission to meet the gap in Revenue Accounts of the States post devolution.States which still show revenue deficit post devolution are recommended Revenue Deficit Grants. en: MIZORAM CHIEF SECRETARY LEADS GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES IN TAKING INTEGRITY PLEDGE 275/2023-2024 Vigilance Awareness Week, 2023 is to be observed in the whole of India from today, i.e. 30th October till 5th November, 2023. This year the theme is - 'Say no to corruption, commit to the Nation'. Starting off the Vigilance Week in Mizoram too, Chief Secretary Dr. Renu Sharma led the officials and staff of the Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO this morning in taking the 'Integrity Pledge' in the Secretariat Courtyard. Likewise, all Heads of Offices under the State Government also led the employees in their respective offices in taking the Integrity Pledge, in which each government servant avowed to follow probity and rule of law in all walks of life, to neither take nor offer bribe, to perform all tasks in an honest and transparent manner, to act in public interest, to lead by example exhibiting integrity in personal behavior and to report any incident of corruption to the appropriate agency. mz: MIZORAM CHIEF SECRETARY HOVIN INTEGRITY PLEDGE THUTIAM CHHAM RUAL 2547/2023-2024 Vawiin ni 30th October atanga 5th November, 2023 chhungin India rampumah Vigilance Awareness Week, 2023 hman a ni dawn a. Kumin Vigilance Week thupui chu - 'Hlemhletna hnawl la, ram tan thawk rawh' (Say no to corruption, commit to the Nation) a ni. Ram hmundangte rualin vawiin chawhma khan Mizoramah pawh 'Vigilance Week 2023' hawn nan Chief Secretary Dr. Renu Sharma kaihhruaina hnuaiah Mizoram Secretariat, MINECO-a sorkar hnathawk, officials and staff zawng zawngten a huhovin 'Integrity Pledge' thuchham an chham rual a. Sorkar office tina Heads of Office-te pawhin an hnuaia thawk officer leh staff-te nen anmahni office hmun theuhah 'Integrity Pledge' hi an chhamrual bawk a ni. en: We should then ask, “What is the church?” The church is thatpartwhichistakenoutofChrist.Weneedtoseethetwo aspects of Adam, and then it will be easy for us to under- stand. On one hand, Adam stands merely as himself; on the otherhand,heisatype.AsfarasAdamhimselfisconcerned, he was made of clay. All natural men are made of clay. But Adam also typified Christ. The fact that Eve was made from Adam signifies that the church is made from Christ.Eve was made with Adam’s rib. Since Eve came outfrom Adam, she was still Adam. Then what is the church? The church is another form of Christ, just as Eve was another form of Adam.

en: HEALTH MINISTER DR. R. LALTHANGLIANA FLAGGED OFF 11 MOBILE MEDICAL VAN IN MAMIT DISTRICT No.541/2020-2021 Dr. R. Lalthangliana Health Minister flagged off 11 Bolero Campers designed for Mobile medical van to be used in rural areas of Mamit Aspiration District. Health Minister specially thank REC Ltd for their selfless help through their CSR initiatives in fostering aspiring district like Mamit which would help them aspire i in various development fields. Bolero Camper (4WD BS6) 11 nos were bought for - Rs. 1,04,50,000/- under REC Ltd. CSR initiative as reported by Nodal Officer Beitlotha Nohro. Also Laptop & Speaker consisting of 52 nunbers worth Rs. 24,60,000/- was also handed over by the minister to CMO and DMS Mamit District hospital. Essential Drugs & Diagnostic kits 76 nos - worth Rs.15,60,000/- and Folic Acid, Oral rehydration salt, Ibuprofen, Ascorbic Acid (vitamin C), Albendazole, Paracetamol and other Diagnostic Kits of 50 nos and Sahli's Haemoglobinometer, Pregnancy Test Kit, Malaria Test Kit, Typhoid Test Kit, BP Instrument Mercurial, Adult Weighing Machine, Hepatitis B-Test Kit etc were given out in the same programme. Er. H. Lalzirliana, Mamit A/C MLA, Pu C. Lalrammawia, Chairman ZOHANCO, Health Department Officials and NGOs and Village Council leaders were present at the programme. The Flagged off programme was chaired by the DC Mamit himself Dr. Lalrozama IAS. Attachment Loading attachment...
mz: HEALTH MINISTER-IN MAMIT DISTRICT CHHUNGA HMAN TUR MOBILE MEDICAL VAN LEH HMANRAW DANGTE VAILIAM No.7589/2020-2021 Vawiin khan Dr. R. Lalthangliana, Minister, Health & Family Welfare Department, Higher & Technical Education, Commerce & Industries chuan Mobile Medical Van, Essential Drugs & Diagnostic Kits & Laptops and Speaker Mamit District Hospital, PHC/CHC leh Sub- Centre-a hman tur vailiam. Khuallian Dr. R Lalthangliana chuan Mamit District chhunga cheng te'n hriselna kawnga hma an sawn theihna tura hmanraw tangkai tak taka thuam an ni chu a lawmawm thusawiin District - 11 zinga Medical Doctor ngei District Bawrhsap, hriselna kawnga a ngaihna hria in nei chu in vannei takzet a. Aspirational District atangin Mizoram District 11- te zingah pakhatna ni thei tura tan la tura chahin in tum tlat chuan theihloh a awm lo a ni tiin kum zabi 21-a hmasawnna chu hmang tangkaiin dik taka kan hmachhawn chuan District hnufual ber thin kha a ropui ber kan ni thei a ni a ti. Dr. Thangtea chuan Pathian ringtu mizo nih hi a nuama, pi leh pute atanga lungrual tak leh inpumkhatna nena thawkho thin kan nihna chuan rah tha chhuah zelin, Covid - 19 avanga nunna chan kan nei erawh pawi hle rualin hri dona kawnga kan hmalakna-a hlawhtlinna kan hmuh mekte leh India hmarchhak State pariat (8) zingah Covid - 19 vanga thi tlemna ber State kan ni chu Pathian avang leh kan thawhhona avang a ni a ti. Minister chuan hmasawnna kan hmuh mekte chu chho zawnga thlira in delhbeh tir mai lovin hmasawnna tluantling nei turin kan tih ve theih tawk theuha tan la thar turin kalkhawmte a fuih a. Kawngpui tha nei turin hmalakna kalpui mek niin khawchhak lam atanga khawthlang lam hawiin kawngsial hna thawh tan mek a nih thu a sawi bawk. Er. H. Lalzirliana, Bialtu MLA pawhin Mamit District-in hriselna kawnga hma kan sawn theihna tur leh Aspirational District kan nihna atanga khaichhuah kan nihna tura CSR hnuai atanga hmanraw tangkai tak tak lei a ni chu lawmawm a tih thusawiin Kan District Bawrhsap-in hemi kawnga hma a lakna chu fakawm a tih thu a sawi a. Covid-19 hripuiin khawvel a tih buai mek karah Mizoram chu Sorkar hmalakna chak tak a vang te, Kohhran mite tawngtaina vang te leh khawtlang hruaitute hmalakna avangin India ram state zingah a titha ber pawl kan ni chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk. Bialtu MLA chuan Mamit District-in kawngpui tha kan neih chu Mizoram Sawrkarin a ngaihpawimawh berte zing a mi a nih avangin chak taka hmalakna kalpui a ni a, hun reilote-ah kawngpui tha kan nei thuai a beisei thu a sawi. Mamit District-in hriselna lama hma kan sawna, nu naupai te'n enkawlna tha zawk an dawn a, damdawi an mamawh angte an hmuh theihna tur bakah damlote enkawlna tha zawk leh rang zawk pek an nih theihna tura District chhung PHC/CHC leh Health Sub- Centre-te tana hmanraw lei hi Mamit District Bawrhsap hmalakna-in REC LTD, CSR Health Project hnuai atanga lei a ni. Vawiin-a sem tak Bolero Camper(4WD BS6) 11 lei nan hian Rs. 1,04,50,000/- hman niin Motor-te hi Health Care delivery a bik takin vaccination drive, Health camp conduct leh awareness pekna tur bakah, kawng that lohna hmun, motor naran in a thlen theih lohna khuate awlsam taka thlen theihnan 4 wheeled drive lei a ni a. Rs. 15,60,000/- senga lei damdawi chi hrang hrang 76 - Folic Acid, Oral rehydration salt, Ibuprofen, Ascorbic Acid (vitamin C), Albendazole, Paracetamol leh Diagnostic Kits 50 - Sahli's Haemoglobinometer, Pregnancy Test Kit, Malaria Test Kit, Typhoid Test Kit, BP Instrument Mercurial, Adult Weighing Machine, Hepatitis B-Test Kit leh a dangte Sub Centre/Health & Wellness Centre- te hman tur khuallian hian a hlan bawk. He Project hian a tum ber chu Health & welness Centre hi mi tam zawkin health care services an dawn theihna tur leh a tlawhtute mamawh damdawi leh diagnostic kit te a thlawna pek chhuah a ni a, health and welness centre hi mi tam zawkin hmang tangkaia, an tlawh tam (footfall) nana kalpui a ni. Vawiin vek hian Rs. 24,60,000/- senga lei Laptop leh Speaker 52, Mamit District chhung khua tlawh pawh harsa leh health care facility nei thalo khuate tan awlsam zawka health care provider te an biak pawh zung zung theihna turin Telemedicine atan Health Department hnenah hlan a ni bawk. He hun hi Dr. Lalrozama, IAS, Deputy Commissioner chuan kaihruaiin, Pu Beitlotha Nohro, SDC pawhin report pe-in Health Project hnuaiah Aspirational District kan nih avanga hriselna lama hma kan sawn theihna tura thuam kan nih dante a tarlang a. Dr. Vanlalfela, Chief Medical Officer, Mamit-in lawmthu sawina a nei bawk. Minister hi Er. H. Lalzirliana, 3-Mamit Bialtu MLA, Pu C. Lalrammawia, Chairman, ZOHANCO, Health Department Officials, Mamit khawpui chhunga Head of Offices bakah khawtlang hruaitute'n leh thutharthehdarhtute'n an tawiawm a ni. en: In Isaiah 39 we are told that when the news of Hezekiah’s sickness and recovery reached the Babylonian court, messengers were dispatched with letters and a present for Hezekiah. Hezekiah had been a recipient of the grace of God, but he was unable to stand the test of grace. God’s Word says, “And Hezekiah was glad for them and showed them his treasury, the silver and the gold, and the spices and the precious oil, and his whole armory and everything which was found among his treasures” (v. 2). Hezekiah could not overcome the temptation to display everything. He had just been wonderfully healed of his sickness and no doubt felt self-important and thought there were few people in the world who had had such a remarkable experience as he. en: DECLAMATION CONTEST ON MY BHARAT-VIKSIT BHARAT, 2047 HELD IN LUNGLEI. 329/2023-2024 LUNGLEI; the 12th, January, 2024: National Youth Day-2024 celebration was held at Art & Culture Auditorium here in Venglai Lunglei, and the function was organized by Nehru Yuva Kendra in collaboration with YMA Sub Hqrs,Lunglei. To commemorate this auspicious day; a Declamation contest on My Bharat-Viksit Bharat@2047 was conducted for the youths of age between 15 to 29. National Youth Day- 2024 celebration function was presided over by Shri CMS Dawngliana Vice President, YMA Sub Hqrs,Lunglei and Shri Lalzuithanga Khiangte, Chairman,Lunglei Municipal Council graced the function as Chief Guest. Speaking on the occasion Shri Lalzuithanga Khiangte spoke at length the huge contribution made by Swami Vivekananda towards society in regard to reformation and upliftment of downtroddens;and exhorted the youths to emulate and follow the footsteps of the pious and sagacious Swami Vivekananda in every possible way. He also passionately reasoned the youths that it was a high time that they buckle up their belts and tighten up their shoe laces to embark upon the future- long road ahead with gusto, and saying a â€˜Big Noâ€™ to all the social vices on their way, for the good of society and for themselves. Shri Lalrinchhana, NYK Lunglei informed the gathering audiences; the purpose of observance of National Youth Day/ National Youth Week and added that 12th January is the birth day of Swami Vivekananda and Government of India decided to observe this day as National Youth Day since 1984, and henceforth 13 th -19 th January was observed as the National Youth Week; and during this week various events and functions were held to inform and motivate the youths across India by imparting the teaching of Swami Vivekananda. Shri Lalthabuanga, officer i/c Traffic delivered lectures on â€œRoad safetyâ€ on this occasion. Attachment Loading attachment...

en: HEALTH MINISTER INAUGURATES 43RD ANNUAL CONFERENCE OF IMA, MIZORAM STATE BRANCH The Indian Medical Association (IMA), Mizoram State Branch observed its 43rd annual conference today at Aijal Club where the Minister for Health and Family Welfare Department Dr.R.Lalthangliana was the Chief Guest. The theme of this yearâ€™s conference is â€œEnding the HIV&AIDS Epidemic: Community by Communityâ€. Speaking at the inaugural function, the Minister said that the government is committed to advance public health efforts and improve health for all. He encouraged the medical community to revive their efforts and recommit themselves in serving the public. Established in 1976, the Mizoram State Branch of IMA currently has 750 members out of which 33 are newly inducted. The Mizoram State Branch received two prestigious awards this year, namely the IMA Special Award for Organizing (IMA North East Leaders Meet Conclave) and President Appreciation Award (for IMA Membership Drive Trophy) from the IMA General Headquarters. The IMA is a voluntary organization where all doctors, whether employed by the government or practising in private, are registered members. The organization looks after the interest of doctors as well as the well being of the community at large. It aims to promote medical and its allied sciences, improve public health and maintain honour and dignity of the medical profession.
mz: HEALTH MINISTER-IN IMA MIZORAM BRANCH CONFERENCE A HMANPUI Vawiin khan Indian Medical Association (IMA) Mizoram State Branch chuan Aijal Club-ah Annual Conference vawi 43-na an hmang a. Dr R.Lalthangliana, Health Minister chu khuallian a ni. Kumin IMA Annual Conference thupui atan â€œEnding the HIV&AIDS Epidemic: Community by Communityâ€ tih thupuiah an hmang. en: Did Paul disclose all his revelations? Far from it. He wrote, “I know a man [who is himself] in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body I do not know, or outside the body I do not know; God knows) such a one was caught away to the third heaven” (v. 2). He did not divulge this experience until fourteen years later. What depth there was in Paul! It would be a wonder if we could hide away something we received from God for seven years. But for fourteen years Paul never divulged his experience; for fourteen years God’s church knew nothing of it; for fourteen years not one of the apostles had heard of it. Paul’s roots were deep beneath the soil.

en: MYC CHAIRMAN LAYS FOUNDATION STONE FOR MYC INCUBATION CENTRE AT SERKAWN, LUNGLEI No.573/2021-2022 Aizawl the 28th March, 2022 : MYC Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia, Lunglei North MLA laid the foundation stone for Mizoram Youth Commission Incubation Centre at Serkawn,Lunglei near Lena Stadium on Saturday (26th March, 2022). The land for the Incubation Centre was donated by Serkawn VC. Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Pu H. Lalnunzuala, Under Secretary MYC, Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub-Headquarters Lunglei and representatives from Serkawn locality and various NGOs were also present at the occasion. On the occasion of this foundation stone laying ceremony, MYC Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia said this centre would cater to the needs of aspiring Mizo youths such as competitive coaching, Information Technology, skill development and entrepreneurship. He thanked the local leaders of Serkawn who donated the property to MYC, and promised them that the centre would be used for the betterment of society and the economy. Talking about the MYC Coaching Centres in Lunglei, Siaha, Kolasib Districts and the one in Champhai which will be opened shortly, the MYC Chairman said that he along with the MYC team would continue working in earnest for the advancement of Mizo youths to the best of their capabilities. He stated that construction of MYC Youth Centres are underway at Aizawl,Serchhip and Lunglei. In addition to competitive exams, MYC is planning to continue to provide cement mistiri training, food processing training, cake baking training, cabin crew, Army Pre-Recruitment training and promotion of music and sports to help the youths reach their goals at the national level. The MYC Chairman said that the MYC Super IAS 20 which was started in 2020 will be upgraded to Super IAS 40 which will comprise of 20 more aspirants. He further said that the road connecting Khawiva, Aizawl-Thenzawl-Lunglei road and roads in Lunglei town will be repaired and that the budget for the improvement works for MZU Southern Campus is raised to Rs.15 crore. Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng shared that although the staff of MYC are few in number, their contributions to the future of Mizo youths are commendable. He stated his appreciation for the Incubation Centre and urged the people to make the most out of this centre. Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub-Headquarters Lunglei and Pu K. Zodinsanga, VCP Serkawn also gave a brief speech, Pu Lalmuanzuala, CC, MYC Lunglei ended the ceremony with vote of thanks speech. Attachment Loading attachment...

MYC Incubation Centre hmun tur hi Lena Stadium bulah awmin a ram hi Serkawn VC te pek a ni. He hunah hian Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Pu H. Lalnunzuala, Under Secretary MYC, Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub Hqrs Lunglei leh Serkawn khawtlang hruaitute leh tlawmngai pawl hrang hrang aiawhte an tel a ni. Mizoram Youth Commission Chairman Dr Vanlaltanpuia chuan MYC Incubation Centre-ah hian thalaite hmasawnna tura hmalakna hrang hrang â€“ competitive coaching, Information Technology, skill development leh entrepreneurship-te a len vek tur thu sawiin residential tura ruahman a nih thu a sawi a. Thalaite hmakhua ngaia an ram phal taka pe tu Serkawn khawtlang te chungah lawmthu sawiin an ram pek chu kan human resource tih hmasawnna kawngah leh kan ram economy than len zelna kawngah tangkai taka hman anih tur thu a sawi. A sawi zel naah MYC Chairman chuan Mizo thalaite hmasawnna turin MYC chuan theihtawp a chhuah zel dawn a ni tiin Lunglei, Siaha leh Kolasib District -ah te MYC Coaching Centre hawn tawh niin Champhai ah pawh hawn leh thuai tum a ni a. Aizawl leh Serchhip ah MYC Youth Centre sak mek niin, Lunglei ah MYC Youth Centre sak mek pawh zawhfel tep a nih thu a sawi. Mizo thalaite hawizau zela, National level chona va man phak ve tura kawng kawhhmuh zel MYC chuan a tum thu sawiin competitive exam coaching mai bakah cement mistiri training, food processing training, cake baking training, cabin crew, Army Pre-Recruitment training, music leh sports lamah te hmalakna kal mekin heng hmalaknte hi zau zawka kalpui zel tum anih thu a sawi. Kum 2020 atanga kalpui MYC Super IAS 20 chungchang pawh sawilangin MYC Chairman chuan heng zirlai thlanchhuah 20 te hi MYC sponsor in Delhi ah thla thum (February â€“ March 2021) coaching zuk kalin MYC nena agreement an neih ang ngei in UPSC Preliminary Exam 2021 chu an zavaiin an ziak veka. Agreement-ah hian MYC Super IAS 20 te hian UPSC 2021 an tlin loh chuan kum thum dang (2022-2024) preliminary exam an bei leh tura tih niin hemi karah hian state level competitive exam emaw exam dang an ziah phalsak an ni a. Heng exam te an ziah avang hian kan agreement an bawhchhe lo a ni, a ti a. Super IAS hi zau zawka kalpui tum niin Super IAS 40 kalpui turin budget ah cheng vaibelchhe 2 dah fel tawh a nih thu sawiin chhimlam District zirlaite lo ngaihven ve ngei turin a chah a ni. Hemi bakah hian Khawiva panna kawng, Aizawl-Thenzawl-Lunglei kawng leh Lunglei khawpui chhung kawng te siam that tur anih thu sawiin MZU Southern Campus tura ruahman chei that hna pawh tluang taka kalin a budget hi cheng vaibelchhe 15 ah tihpun anih thu a sawi bawk. Lunglei High Powered Committee Vice Chairman Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng pawhin thu sawiin MYC hnuaiah thawktu staff tlemte chauh awm mahse Mizo thalaite tana an hmalakna hi a hlu in a chhuanawm takzet a ni, a ti a. Lunglei khawpui ah zirna in changtlung tak Incubation Centre kan nei tur chu kan vannei takzet a, mipuiten kan hlut a kan hman tangkai thiam a tul dawn a ni tiin Lunglei District thalaite chu tun aia hawizau tur leh tih tak takna nena hma la turin a sawm a ni. Vawiin program-ah hian Pu Lalrotluanga, President YMA Sub Hqrs Lunglei leh Pu K. Zodinsanga, VCP Serkawn te pawhin thu sawiin Pu Lalmuanzuala, CC, MYC Lunglei in lawmthu sawina hun a hmang a ni. en: GOVT. ITI, AIZAWL CONVOCATION DAY 176/2022-2023 Aizawl the 19th September, 2022 : For the first time in its history, Govt. Industrial Training Institute of Aizawl, Mizoram organized a Convocation programme on 17th September, 2022 for 143 students who have completed their various courses. In the academic session of 2022-2023, Govt. ITI College enrolled 384 students and the Institute registered an overall passed percentage of 97.14% which is the Instituteâ€™s best record since its inception. With this record the Institute ranked at sixth place in the country. At this Convocation programme Certificates were handed out to the 143 students who have successfully completed their courses. The Convocation programme started with a welcome address by Mr. K. Lalhmingliana, Director, LESDE department who felicitated the students on their accomplishments. Honâ€™ble Chief Guest Mr. Lalramsanga Sailo, Secretary, LESDE Department lauded Govt. ITI Aizawl for having one of the best results among hundreds of ITIâ€™s in the country. He highlighted the importance of upgrading ITIâ€™s in Mizoram towards development of skill and for self â€“employment of the youth of Mizoram. He also mentioned that many of the local technicians in Mizoram are former students of ITIâ€™s and among the recently graduated students of Motor Mechanic Vehicle (MMV), 14 of them have secured a letter of appointment from major companies even before announcement of their final results. This is the first time that the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE) has organized a Convocation programme for the entire country and further planned to celebrate it every year. The main programme was held at New Delhi in commemoration on the day of Vishwakarman Diwas(Day) with our honâ€™ble Prime Minister virtually addressing the Convocation. The Convocation function closed with the Chief Guest handing out a small award to the Top-3 meritorious students in various discipline. First - Lalpekthara, Electronics Mechanic Second - F Lalrammawia, Baker & Confectionery, Hmangaihsangzuali, Stenography Third - LalawmpuiaSailo, Stenography, Lalthlamuani, Baker & Confectionery The programme was attended by the students and Instructor of Industrial Training Institute along with noteworthy alumni and representatives from the industry sector. en: FINAL ELECTORAL ROLLS FOR BY-ELECTION TO TOKALO MDC CONSTITUENCY PUBLISHED District Election Officer & Deputy Commissioner of Siaha District, Shri.Bhupesh Chaudhary IAS published and handed over Final E/Rolls for By-Election to Tokalo MDC Constituency, to the representatives of various Political Parties in Hard & Soft copy, at his office chamber, here at Siaha tomorrow. Tokalo MDC constituency was declared as vacant constituency due to the untimely demise of its incumbent MDC Shri. K.L Bana and his Death prompted a By-Election. Basing 1st January, 2019 as qualifying date, a Summary Revision of E/Rolls had been be carried out smoothly as per the Schedule prescribed by SEC. Final E/Rolls Publication event was attended by: Shri.K.Vanlalthiana,Addl.DC, Shri. Amol Srivastava IAS, Asst.Commissioner, H.Zonunmawia, Election Officer, Shri. N.Vabeiratlua, DIPRO,Representatives of MTP(H), MCHP(H) and various Political Parties. A just published Final E/Rolls consisted of 450 female voters and 505 male voters, totalling to 955 voters in all. Attachment Loading attachment...
mz: TOKALO MDC CONSTITUENCY BY- ELECTION A HMAN TUR FINAL ELECTORAL ROLLS TLANGZARH Nimin (15.10.2019) chawhnu dar 1:00Pm khan District Election Officer leh Bawrhsap ni bawk Pu Bhupesh Chaudhary IAS chuan a office chamber-ah Tokalo Constituency a MDC By-Election neih huna hman tur Final E/Rolls a tlangzarhin, political party hrang hrang aiawhte hnenah Final E/Rolls chu a Hard leh Soft Copy in a hlan nghal hlawm a ni. Tokalo bialtu MDC Pu K.L Bana a boral tak avanga By-Election hi neih tur a ni. 1st January, 2019 hi qualifying date a hmangin, State Election Commission duan angin Summary Revision of E/Rolls hi tluang taka kalpui niin, vawiin hi Final E/Rolls tlangzarh tura ni ruat a ni. Final E/Rolls tlangzarhna-ah hian Pu K.Vanlalthiana,Addl.DC, Pu Amol Srivastava IAS,Asst.Commissioner, Pu H.Zonunmawia, Election Officer, Pu N.Vabeiratlua, DIPRO, Tlawmngai Pawl MTP(H) leh MCHP(H) aiawh te leh Political Party hrang hrang aiawhte an tel a ni. en: SPORTS MINISTER LAUDS MIZORAM GIRLSâ€™ VICTORY IN NES U-19 FOOTBALL CHAMPIONSHIP Headquarters 23 Sector Assam Rifles today organised a felicitation programme at Loch Hall within the precincts of 46 Assam Rifles, Aizawl for team members of the Mizoram U-19 Girls Team who recently lifted the Assam Rifles organized North East States Under-19 Championship held during July 17-21 at Diphu and Kohima. Sports Minister Shri Robert Romawia Royte presided over the function and lauded the efforts of the team members and the support provided by the Assam Rifles. Speaking on the occasion, the Minister highlighted the role football has played in connecting the North Eastern states with the rest of the country and said that it is an important tool in strengthening national integration and in helping the region mainstream with the rest of the country. Appreciating the cooperation between the Mizoram Government and Mizoram Football Association (MFA) in furthering the cause of football, the Minister expressed hope that this partnership will grow stronger and reach new heights in the coming days. He said that the Government will support MFA and other sports organizations and associations in all the possible way whether through financial assistance or otherwise. He pointed that for the first time ever Mizoram will soon have a comprehensive sports policy â€˜Mizoram Sports Policyâ€™ and through this policy Mizoram will achieve accolades in sports, he added. The Minister also spelt out new initiatives in the pipeline for development of football in the state and said that Flood Lighting and other works of Rajiv Gandhi Stadium to meet international standards will soon be completed. MFA President Shri Lal Thanzara and other office bearers of MFA were also present on the occasion. Attachment Loading attachment...
mz: SPORTS MINISTER HOVIN NES U-19 TEAM TE CHAWIMAWI Headquarters 23 Sector Assam Rifles bultumin vawiin khan Loch Hall, 46 Assam Rifles hmunpui ah tun hnaia neih NES Under-19 Women Football Championship a champion Mizoram Team te chawimawi hun â€˜Felicitation Programmeâ€™ buatsaih a ni a. He hun hi Sports Minister Pu Robert Romawia Royteâ€™n a hmanpui a. Mizoram Football Association (MFA) hruaitute pawh he hunah hian an tel bawk a ni. Sports Minister Pu Robert Romawia Royte chuan Mizoram Hmeichhe U-19 Team in NES U-19 Championship a, champion an ni chu a lawmpuiin thu sawiin he hnehna hi Sawrkar ta emaw, a buatsaihtu leh buaipuitu Assam Rifles ta emaw, MFA ta emaw a ni lova, Mizoram mipui zawng zawng ta a ni tiin team te chu Mizoram mipui chhuanvawr an nih thu a sawi. Mizoram Hmeichhe team in Nagaland Hmeichhe team, India aiawh tunhnaia international level a tel te, an hneh hian kan hmeichhe footballer te an that zia a tih lan thu a sawi lang a. MFA in football thanna atan an hmalakna te chu Sawrkar ang pawhin a thei ang angin belhchaha, tiphuia , tichak turin Sawrkar in hma a lak zel tur thu a sawi a, Sawrkar leh MFA thawhona tha tak chu chhunzawm zela, tichak turin MFA hruaitute a sawm bawk a ni. Pu Robert Romawia Royte chuan football chu hnam impumkhatna leh a tihchakna hmanraw tha tak anih dan sawiin football avangin Hmarchhak state leh India hmun dangte kan in pawh tha leh zual a, inuanau boruak tha zawk siamin hnam inpumkhatna a tichak a, football thil tih theihna hi a ropui a, ngaihnep theih a ni lo tih a sawi. Sawrkar chuan football rualin sports discipline dangte tun aia nasa leh zawka hmasawn tir a duh avangin Mizoram in ala neih ngai lo Mizoram Sports Policy chu buaipui mek a nih tih sawiin taekwondo, basketball, volleyball leh sports discipline te than dan chu a lawmawm a, sports association te tichak turin Sawrkarin ngaihtuahna a sen mek a, inrelbawlna tha zawka kan neih thei nan Sports Minister a nih ang pawhin theihtawp a chhuah tur thu a sawilang a. International level match thleng thei turin Rajiv Gandhi Sports Stadium ah Flood Lighting tha tak a awm thei an hma lak mek a nih thu te, Aizawl khawpuia football field dang 4/5 vel siamna tur hmun dap mek a nih thu te, Zembawk field atan grass phahna tur sanction a awm tawh thu te leh Khawzawl field ah pawh grass phah turin ruahmanna siam mek a nih thu te a sawi lang bawk a ni. Sports Minister chuan Assam Rifles in Football leh Mizo thalaite hmasawnna atana an inpekna chu fawkawm tiin he thawhona tha hi chhunzawm zela, Mizoram thalaite hmasawnna leh an talen te phochhuahna kawnga theihtawp chhuahpui zel turin a sawm bawk a ni. He hunah hian HQ 23 Sector Assam Rifles hotupa, Brig. Vinod S. Leh MFA President Pu Lal Thanzara te pawhin thusawiin infiamite an fuih a ni. U-19 Team a tel zawngte hi Assam Rifles hian thilpek an hlan bawk a ni. North East States U-19 Girls Football Championship hi Directorate General Assam Rifles (DGAR) chuan Diphu leh Kohima ah te July ni 17 leh July ni 21 inkar khan a buatsaih a, he Championship Mizoram team an champion a ni. en: B ut, brothers and sisters, is this good enough? I think when we meet those who enjoy Christ as their daily manna, we are very happy. We say, “Oh, praise the Lord, here are some brothers and sisters who really enjoy the Lord as their manna day by day!” But we must realize that this falls far short of God’s purpose. God’s purpose is not just that we enjoy Christ a little, but that He should be the all-inclusive One to us. Look at this verse: “As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him” (Col. 2:6). He is a sphere, a realm for us to walk in. General Sharma, on behalf of Mizoram expressed his gratitude for a rare and distinguish visit by a diplomat of the Holy See. en: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati visits Sainik School Chhingchhip 191/2022-2023 Chhingchhip, the 30th September 2022: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati who is on an official tour of Serchhip District visited Sainik School, Chhingchhip, a few miles away from Serchhip town today. Upon his arrival, Governor was accorded the Guard of Honour by 8 Bn of Assam Rifles. He was then introduced to the staff by Wcdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, and Maj S.Kalyan, Administrative Officer. A briefing about the School to Governor was given by the Principal in his office room. After this, an official function with a cultural program was organized inside the Assembly Hall in honour of the esteemed visitor. Here, the Governor addressed the students. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati congratulated faculties for their best effort to keep up with other establishwd Sainik Schools in the country. He thanked the state government for bring up a highly valuable asset of national importance in education like Sainik school here in Mizoram. He expressed his pride of having the first Sainik School in the country where girl students are admitted. He stressed the importance of Sainik Schools for preparing the young students to become cadet officers in Army, Airforces and Navy. Beside this, he said the school also prepared the students to become role model students and role model citizen. He reminded the students of the school about their important duties for the national integration of the county. Full speech of the Honble Governor : https://dipr.mizoram.gov.in/post/speech-of-dr-hari-babu-kambhampati-honble-governor-of-mizoram-on-the-occasion-of-visit-to-sainik-school-chhingchhip-on-30th-september-2022 The programme began with welcome address by Maj S.Kalyan, Admn and concluded with vote of thanks proposed by WCdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, Sainik School, Chhingchhip. After the official programme, Governor inspected the facilities inside the campus of Sainik School Chhingchhip. As per the briefing by the Principal, here are the few highlights of the school. The school is now 6 years old and running with the pilot cadets in Class XI. The annual intake of students are 60 boys and 10 girls in the class VI while in the class IX only boys are admitted with the availability of 10 seats for students annually. The annual fee per a student is estimated at Rs 1.85 lakh per year. The schools have daily routine for winter and summer and winter with the physical and classroom activities through out the day. It usually starts from very early morning till 9:00 to 9:30 PM at night. Apart from the facilities for cocurricular activities, the School is also currently having the facilities like Football Ground, Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Gynasium, Music room,etc.,. The swimming pool, parade ground and other big sports facilities are being planned to be added very soon. The Principal highlighted the status of Grant in Aid from the state, issues with water and power bills, LMV ambulance to be received from the Mizoram Rural Bank through CSR, INSAS rifles to be received from Home Department, Government of Mizoram, Infrastructural Fund received to the tune of Rs 99,96,000 the Ministry of Defence with the proposed implementations. To solve the issue with high power bills, the Governor advised implementation of Solar Power Generation plant inside the campus. While, the issue with high water bills is being taken up the office Deputy Commissioner and is expected to be solved very soon. Governor in his visit to Sainik School, Chhingchhip was escorted and given a company by Pu Lalmuansanga Ralte, Addl DC and Pu Stephen Lalrinawma, SP, Serchhip District. mz: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati in Sainik School Chhingchhip a tlawh 2122/2022-2023 Chhingchhip, the 30th September 2022: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan vawiin khan Sainik School Chhingchhip a tlawh a. He hunah hian School building leh hmunhma te a endik a, Sikul naupangte hmaah fuihna thu a sawi bawk a ni. Governor hian Sainik School a thlenin amah zahna chibai 8 Bn Assam Rifles ten School kawtah an lo buk a. Wcdr Shahul Hameed, Principal leh Maj S.Kalyan, Administrative Officer ten zirtirtute leh School staff te an hmelhriattir chhunzawm a. Hemi zawh hian Principal Office ah Sainik School dinhmunte inhrilhhriatna hun neih leh a ni a. Assembly Hall-ah Official programme leh Cultural Programme neih chhunzawm nghal a ni. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Principal leh a thawhpui ten Sainik School tha tak ni tur leh hmun danga Sainik School te dinhmun pha tura theihtawp an chhuah chu fakawm a tih thu a sawi hmasa a. Mizoram sawrkarin hetiang ang School tha bik Mizorama zirlaite tan a buatsaih thei chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk a ni. Sainik School Chhingchhip hi India ram hmundang te aia a danglam bik na chu helai hmunah hian Sainik School dangte entawn turin a vawikhatna atana leh a hmahruaitu ni turin hmeichhe naupangte luh tir an ni a. Hei hi a chhuanawm tak zet a ni a ti. Sainik School te hi khawi hmunah pawh School thabik an ni a, Sipai, Navy leh Airforce Officer ni turin a bik takin heng schoolah te hian zirlai te zirtirna pek a ni a ti. Sainik School a zirlaite hi Armed Forces ah an thawkvek kher lo a nih pawhin khawtlang leh ram tana khua leh tui entawn tlak ni tura chher an nih thu a sawi bawk. India chakna chu danglamna tam tak kara inpumkhatna leh inunauna tha a ni tih zirlaite chu a hrilh nawn leh a. He mawhphurhna huangah hian Sainik School zirlaite chu hmahruaitu ni turin a chah a ni. Hemi hnu hian Assembly Hall chhunga programme hi tan a ni a. Zirlai ten Governor pualin Cultural programme an hmang a. WCdr Shahul Hameed, Principal, Sainik School, Chhingchhip chuan lawmthu sawiin huntawp a khar a ni. Official programme zawh hian Saini School Campus chhunga School building leh hmunhma te Governor chuan a endik chhunzawm nghal a ni. Principal Report atanga a lan dan chuan Sainik School Chhingchhip hi kum 6 hmel a hmu mek a. Tunah hian batch hmasa ber(Class VI) te chu Class XI an ni mek a ni. Sainik School a lut tur hian All India Entrance Test paltlang a ngai a. Sikul naupang pakhat tana kum khat chhunga senso chu Rs 1.85 lakh velah chhut a ni. Kumtin Class VI ah hian mipa naupang 60 leh Hmeichhe naupang 10 admission pek an ni mek a. Class IX ah erawh chuan mipa chiah admission pek niin kum tin seat 10 a awm thin a ni. School naupangte hian zing dar 5 vel atangin zan dar 9:30 vel thleng nitin, lehkha zirna hun, infiamna leh thildang tangkai zir nan hun an hmang thin a. Lehkha zirna leh a kaihhnaih(cocurricular activities) bakah zirlaite tan hian taksa insawizawina leh themthiamna chidangte ( extracurricular activities) atana hmunhma pawimawh Football Ground, Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Gynasium, Music room,etc., te he school hian a nei a. Swimming pool, parade ground leh sports facility tangkai tak tak buatsaih chhoh zel a tum bawk. Principal hian Mizoram sawrkar in tanpuina a pek thin - GIA dinhmun te, Ambulance te chi MRB in CSR kaltlanga pek a tum chungchang te, NCC te tana tangkai INSAS silai Home Department, Govt of Mizoram in pek a tum chunchang te Rs 99,96,000 school tihphuisuina atana Ministry of Defence atang sum lo kal tur chungchangte a sawi a. An harsatna pahnih Tui Bill sang tak leh Electric chhit man sang lutuk chungchangte pawh sawi a ni. Kawlphetha a harsatna sutkian a nih theih nan campus chhunga Solar Power Generation Plant bun turin Governor chuan Sainik School Chhingchhip hotute chu thurawn a pe a. Tui bill chungchang pawh Serchhip DC office leh PHED ten chinfel sak turin hma an la mek tih sawi a ni. en: ASSAM RIFLES BATTALION TO CONDUCT 8TH ROZGAR MELA FOR MIZORAM STATE 195/2023-2024 Aizawl the 26th August, 2023 - Battalion of Headquarters Inspector General Assam Rifles (East) will be conducting 8th Rozgar Mela on 28 August 2023 at 2 AR Gajraj Hall, Lakhimpur Battalion. A large number of individuals will be benefitted by the Mela. Central Government is set to organize the 8th Job Fair on 28 August 2023. This event, spanning over 25 states and more than 44 locations, will see the distribution of appointment letters to approximately 70,000 young individuals of various Departments of the Indian Government. Notably, our Honorable Prime Minister Narendra Modi will preside over the event, addressing the youth through live streaming, followed by the distribution of appointment letter to the candidates present. Assam Rifles is playing a pivotal role in organizing the Rozgar Mela for the state of Mizoram and overseeing the eventâ€™s coordination. The Honorable Minister of Minority Affairs, Mr John Barla will personally hand over appointment letter to the candidates. The Honorable Prime Minister will witness the ceremony via Video Conferencing. The Rozgar Mela is a step towards fulfillment of the duty of Government to accord highest priority to employment generation.
mz: ASSAM RIFLES BATTALION-IN ROZGAR MELA BUATSAIH DAWN 1663/2023-2024 Aizawl, the 26th August, 2023: Headquarters Inspector General Assam Rifles (East) hnuaia Assam Rifles Battalion chuan August ni 28, 2023 hian Rozgar Mela/Job Fair tum 8-na 2 AR Gajraj Hall, Lakhimpur Battalion, Aizawl-ah a buatsaih dawn. Sawrkar laipui ruahmannain Rozgar Mela/Job Fair chu August ni 28, Thawhtanni hian State hrang hrang 25 a hmun 44 ahte huaihawt a ni dawn a. He hunah hian Indian Government hnuai Department hrang hranga hna hmu thar mi 70,000 dawnte hnenah appointment letter pek chhuah a ni ang. Prime Minister Pu Narendra Modi chuan ram pum huap hun hman hi a kaihruai dawn a, live streaming kaltlangin thalaite hnena thuchah a sawi hnuah hna hmu thar a hmuna awmte hnenah appointment letter a sem chhuak dawn a ni. Mizorama Rozgar Mela/Job Fair hlawhtling taka huaihawt a nih theih nan Assam Rifles chuan hma a la a, he hun hi Sawrkar laipuia Minister of State for Minority Affairs Pu John Barla chuan a hmanpui dawn a, hna hmu tharte kutah appointment letter a hlan dawn a ni. Ram chhung hmun hrang hranga hun hmante hi Prime Minister chuan Video Conferencing kaltlangin a chhim dawn a ni. Rozgar Mela hi Sawrkar laipuiin hna neilote tana hna a siam sakna kawnga hmalakna ngaih pawimawh tak a ni.

en: G20 CHIEF COORDINATOR SHRI HARSH VARDHAN SHRINGLA ARRIVES IN AIZAWL 319/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 27th January 2023 : G-20 Chief Coordinator Shri Harsh Vardhan Shringla arrived in Aizawl today to inspect the ongoing preparation for the Business-20 meeting scheduled to be held in Mizoram on the 2nd of March, 2023. Soon after his arrival, Shri Harsh Vardhan Shringla proceeded to oversee the preparedness of Lengpui Airport, Mizoram University Auditorium and Multipurpose Hall where the Business-20 meeting will be held. Later in the evening, he will co-chair the meeting of G-20 Core Team with Smt Renu Sharma, Chief Secretary and attend Cultural Evening-cum-dinner to be hosted by Tourism Minister Shri Robert Romawia Royte. Shri Harsh Vardhan Shringla will leave Aizawl tomorrow via Lengpui Airport after calling on the stateâ€™s Chief Minister Shri Zoramthanga. Attachment Loading attachment...
mz: G20 CHIEF COORDINATOR PU HARSH VARDHAN SHRINGLA IN MIZORAM LO THLENG 3386/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 27th January 2023 : Vawiin khan G20 Chief Coordinator Pu Harsh Vardhan Shringla chuan March ni 2 a G20 Business-20 meeting Mizoramin a thlen tur a inbuatsaihna hrang hrang te enfiah turin Aizawl a rawn thleng a. Lengpui Airport-ah Tourism Principal Secretary Pi Manisha Saxena leh State sawrkar official ten an lo hmuak a, Chief Coordinator hi Ministry of External Affairs Additional Secretary leh Financial Advisor ni bawk Pu Vibhu Nayar leh sawrkar laipui official ten an rawn tawiawm a ni. Pu Harsh Vardhan Shringla hian Lengpui tumhmuna inbuatsaihna kal mek te chu enfiah nghalin, Business-20 meeting neihna tur Mizoram University Auditorium leh Multipurpose Hall-te a enfiah nghal bawk ang. Vawiin tlai hian MINECO-ah G-20 Core Team leh a hnuaia committee pengte meeting a neihpui ang a, Chaltlang Tourist Lodge-ah Tourism Minister Pu Robert Romawia Royte in cultural leh dinner programme a buatsaihsak dawn bawk. A. As the Indwelling Spirit
God puts His Spirit in us so that His Spirit may be the indwellingSpiritwithinus,thatwemayknowGodandexpe- rience all that God in Christ has accomplished for us (Rom. 8:9-11). This is the special blessing given by God in the New Testament era; it did not exist in the Old Testament. In the OldTestament,GodonlycausedHisSpirittocomefromwith- out to work upon man; He did not cause His Spirit to dwell withinman. Only after the Lord’s death and resurrection did God give His Spirit to us and cause His Spirit to dwell in us as the indwelling Spirit (John 14:16-17). Thus, He is able to reveal both God and Christ to us from within,that we in Christ may receive and enjoy the fullness of God (Col. 2:9-10).
mz:
A. Chhûnglama Chenchilhtu Thlarau Angin
Pathianin kan chhûngah a thlarau a dah a, tichuan a thlarau chu kan chhûngah chenchilhtu Thlarau a ni ang a, Pathian hriatna leh Pathian lama Krista-in kan tâna a hlenchhuah zawng zawng tawnhriatna kan nei thei dawn a ni (Rom 8:9-11). Hei hi Thuthlung Thar huna malsawmna danglam bik Pathianin a pêk chu a ni a; Thuthlung Hluiah a awm rêng rêng lo a ni. Thuthlung Hluiah chuan Pathian chuan a Thlarau chu pawnlama mihring chunga hnathawk tur ringawtin a siam a, mihring chhûngah chuan a Thlarau chu chenchilh turin a siam lo a ni. Lalpa thihna leh thawhlehna hnuah chauh chuan Pathian chuan a Thlarau chu kan hnenah min pe in, chenchilhtu Thlarau angin Thlarau chu kan chhûnga nung turin a siam a (John. 14:16-17). Hei vâng hian kan chhûnglam aṭangin Pathian leh Krista chu a puangchhuak thei a, tichuan Pathian khahna chu keini Krista ami ten kan lo dawn a kan chen theihna turin a ni (Kol. 2:9-10).

en: In the Scriptures, only 1 John 2:27 speaks of the “teach- ing of the anointing.” We all know that anointing is a verbal noun which refers to the activity of the ointment, the mov- ing and the working of the ointment.According to the type of the Old Testament and the fulfillment of the New Testa- ment, ointment or oil in the Scripture refers to the Holy Spirit(Isa.61:1;Luke4:18).Sinceointmentoroilreferstothe Holy Spirit, the “anointing” must refer to the working of the Holy Spirit. The working of the Holy Spirit in us is like the anointing of the ointment; therefore, the Scripture calls this working of the Holy Spirit the “anointing.”

en: FELICITATION PROGRAM HELD FOR LUNGLEI EAST A/C MEDALISTS - MIZORAM STATE GAMES 2019 A felicitation program was held yesterday at the Lunglei BDO Conference Hall to honour medalists who represented the Lunglei East Assembly Constituency at the Mizoram State Games 2019 held on the 2 nd week of December last year. Lunglei East AC MLA, Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng who is also the incumbent Vice Chairman, Lunglei High Powered Committee, graced the occasion as Chief Guest. With a medal tally of 23 (Gold â€“ 7, Silver â€“ 7, Bronze - 9) under various sports disciplines, Lunglei East Assembly Constituency ranked 11 th out of the 40 Assembly Constituencies in Mizoram, and were placed first among the Constituencies under Lunglei District. Congratulating the athletes and the Organizing Committee on their remarkable feat, the Lunglei East AC MLA, Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng praised the team for the grit and determination that they exhibited during the highly competitive Mizoram State Games 2019. He encouraged the young winners to work hard, dream big and set their sights on bigger platforms, even international ones, which, he pointed, out was well within their reach if they played their cards right. He also exhorted upon them to educate themselves on various schemes and benefits available to sportspersons under the state and central governments. en: Floral tributes paid to Mahatma Gandhi in Mizoram No.244/2020-2021 Aizawl the 2nd October, 2020: Floral tributes were paid at the statue of Mahatma Gandhi early this morning at MG Road, Aizawl by the Hon'ble Governor, Chief Minister Deputy Chief Minister and other leaders of the state on the 151st birth anniversary of the Father of the Nation. Governor P.S. Sreedharan Pillai, Chief Minister Zoramthanga, Deputy Chief Minister Tawnluia offered floral wreath on the occasion. Legislative Assembly Speaker and Dy Speaker, Ministers and MLAs, AMC Mayor and important officials also placed floral offering. Celebrated yearly across the country on October 2nd, Gandhi Jayanti is one of the official declared national holidays of India, observed in all of its states and territories. en: CHIEF MINISTER ATTENDED GRADUATION AND LAMP LIGHTING CEREMONY AT RIPANS Chief Minister Pu Zoramthanga attended the Lamp Lighting & Graduation Ceremony at Regional Institute of Paramedical and Nursing Sciences(RIPANS), Aizawl as chief guest yesterday. Speaking on the occassion, the Chief Minister offered his congratulations to the graduates, wishing them success in their future careers. He also encouraged the new B.Sc Nursing students to be diligent in their studies to become exceptional healthcare professionals, which is one of the most noble profession. Speaking of how the government takes various measures to ensure examplary healthcare system, the Chief Minister said that public support is needed for success. In yesterday's function the Chief Minister gave away Proficiency Award to toppers of all departments in the institute. This year saw 180 graduates from RIPANS with 36 B.Sc. Nursing, 40 B.Sc. MLT (Medical Laboratory Technology), 23 B. Pharm, 34 B. Optometry, 31 B.Sc. RIT (Radio Imaging Technology) and 16 M. Pharm. Dr. Chawngthanliana, Director, RIPANS handed out Certificate of Appreciation to the new Graduates and Post Graduates. 35 students of B.Sc Nuring were newly inducted through the Lamp Lighting Ceremony with Pi Lalrinthangi, Nursing Superintendent, Civil Hospital Aizawl as lamp lighter. RIPANS was set up by the Ministry of Home Affairs in 1995-96 under North Eastern Council (NEC). Then it was transferred to the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare on April, 2007. As of 2019, 2820 students have graduated from RIPANS since it's inception in 1996. Presently, there are 655 students enrolled in the six departments the institution offers. With the recommendation of the Meeting of Executive Council of the Institute under the Ministry earlier this year which approved Rs. 480.12 cr. for Upgradation and Development of RIPANS, plans to open seven more departments. Apart from this, creation of 154 posts including that of medical doctors, nurses and other paramedics, and infrastructural developments including hospitals, academic building, sports complex, hostel and quarters are underway. mz: CHIEF MINISTER IN RIPANS AH GRADUATION LEH LAMP LIGHTING CEREMONY A HMANPUI Vawiin khan Chief Minister Pu Zoramthanga chuan Regional Institute of Paramedical and Nursing Sciences(RIPANS) ah kumina Nursing leh Paramedical Course hrang hranga zirlai pass thar te graduation lawmna leh Bachelor of Nursing zirlai thar 35-te lawmluhna Lamp Lighting Ceremony chu khuallian niin a hmanpui a. Zirlai titha zual te hnenah Proficiency Award a hlan bawk. Chief Minister chuan graduate tharte chu a lawmpui thu a sawi a. Mahni mihring puite tan an thiamna hmang a, enkawl dam hna thawh chu hna ropui tak a nih thu sawiin, zirlai pass tharte chu an kal zelna turah pawh taima leh rinawm taka an thawh zui a, hlawhtlinna an chan chhoh zel turin a duhsakna a hlan. Chief Minister chuan Mizoramah mihring hriselna tihhmasawn a inenkawlna tha zawk neih chu sawrkarin a ngaihpawimawh thu a sawi a. Chumi atan chuan sawrkar chauhin thil a tih theihloh thu leh, hriselna kawnga ramin hma a sawn tak tak dawn chuan mipui tawiawmna a mamawh thu a sawi. Chief Minister chuan RIPANS pawh changtlung zawka siam tura hmalakna awm mek chu lawmawm a tih thu sawiin, thawktu indaihlohna avanga harsatna an tawh chungchangah theih tawp chhuahpui a tum thu a sawi a ni. Chief Minister chuan graduate thar te zingah an department theuh a titha zualte hnenah RIPANS Proficiency Award a hlan bawk. Vawiin hunah hian RIPANS Director Dr. Chawngthanliana leh Lamp Lighter Civil Hospital Nursing Superintendent Pi Lalrinthangi ten thu an sawi bawk. BSc Nursing First year hi an vawiin mi 35 an ni a. RIPANS Director Dr. Chawngthanliana chuan Graduate leh Post Graduate tharte hnenah Certificate of Appreciation a hlan a ni. Kumin hian a vaiin mi 180 zirchhuak an awm a. Chungte chu: i) B.Sc. Nursing - 36 ii) B.Sc. MLT (Medical Laboratory Technology) - 40 iii) B. Pharm - 23 iv) B. Optometry - 34 v) B.Sc. RIT (Radio Imaging Technology) - 31 vi) M. Pharm - 16 RIPANS hi kum 1996 khan North Eastern Council (NEC) in India hmarchhak mite tan Paramedical leh Health Sciences bik zirna atana din in, kum 2007 April thla atangin sawrkar laipuia Ministry of Health and Family Welfare hnuaiah dah a ni ta a. Tun dinhmunah Degree Course hrang hrang panga - B.Sc Nursing, B.Sc Medical laboratory Technology, B. Pharm, B. Optometry leh B.Sc Radio Imaging Technology bakah October 2014 atang khan Post Graduate Course M. Pharm te awmin, India hmarchhak state hrang hrang atangin zirlaite tan seat hauhsa (quota) neiih zirlai 655 an awm mek a ni. Kum 1996 atanga kumin 2019 thleng hian RIPANS atanga zirchhuak mi 2820 an awm tawh a ni. Ministry of Health & Family Welfare hnuaia Executive Council meeting kumin kumtir a neihin RIPANS tihchangtlun na turin Rs. 480.12 crores pek a remti a. He hmalakna hnuaiah hian khum 100 awm theihna hospital, Academic building, Indoor Sports Complex cum Auditorium, P.G. Hostel, Guest House, Medical Superintendent Quarter, Doctor Quarter, Nurses/ Staff quarter sakna tur te, thawktu post 154 siam belhna tur leh Course thar pasarih hawnna tur te a tel a ni. en: Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati visits Champhai Tlangsam Winery 326/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 1st February 2023 : Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati, who is on a two-day tour of Champhai District visited the Tlangsam Winery on the outskirt of Champhai Town this evening. At the site, Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati was given an escorted tour to various units by the managing officers of the winery. Thereafter, a short program was held at B Remmawia Packing hall, Champhai Winery. Governor Hari Babu expressed his delight in visiting the factory started, owned, and managed by a society of farmers. He was particularly appreciative of having witness the production centre where the determined farmers themselves added value to their products. He congratulated the Champhai Grape Growers Society and the Hnahlan Grape Growers and Processing Co-operative Society Ltd. Governor welcomed the ambitious proposal to upgrade these wineries at Champhai and Hnahlan to accomodate the growing production of the Grapes in these areas. He extended his support for this proposal and if necessary, he agreed to discuss the matter with the authorities in the Ministry of Food Processing Industries(MoFPI). On behalf of Champhai Winery, Pu Hrilchunglura, General Manager, Champhai Grape Growers Society(GGGS) gave a report. The Winery was started in 2007. After 14 years of existence with the production actually started in 2010 the Winery has now grown. At present the society has 134 members. The fruit is of Bangalore Blue variety. During last year the Winery bought 1144.98 qts of grapes. As the grape production increases, CGGS submitted two projects - one project to MoFPI and another project to state department under Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK). mz: GOVERNOR PU HARI BABU KAMBHAMPATI IN CHAMPHAI WINERY TLAWH, PMUY LEH PMAY-HFA URBAN HAMTHATNA DAWNGTUTE TLAWHIN A KAWM 3449/2022-2023 Champhai, the 1st February, 2023: Ni hnih cham tura Champhai tlawha thang mek Mizoram Governor Pu Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan vawiin chawhnu khan Champhai Winery, Tlangsam tlawhin an hmalaknate a enfiah a; Champhal Grape Growers Society leh Hnahlan Grape Growers and Processing Co-operative Society Limited hotute a kawm bawk. Hemi hnu hian Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) leh Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Housing for All (Urban) hnuaia hamthatna dawngtute tlawhin a kawm a ni. Governor hi Environment, Forest & Climate Change Minister Pu T.J. Lalnuntluanga, Champhai South bialtu MLA ni bawk bakah DC Champhai Pu James Lalrinchhana, SP Pu Lalrinpuia Varte leh Official dangten an tawiawm a ni. Governor Pu Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Champhai Winery tlawh theia a awm chu lawmawm a tih thu sawiin, an hmalaknate engemawchen a lo hriat tawh thu a sawi a. Champhai District-a Winery pahnih lai a awm leh loneitute intelkhawmin an kalpui chu ropui a tih thu a sawi a. Grape chingtuten harsatna an tawh chu pawi a tih thu sawiin, Sawrkarin dan thar siama hma a la chu lawmawm a ti a. Wine siam chu food processing hnuaia a awm anih thu sawiin, agriculture product-te cheibawla siam danglam value addition chu hmalakna pawimawh tak a ni, a ti a. Tun aia nasaa huang zauh leh changtlung zawka kal tura Ministry of Food Processing Industries kaltlanga hmalakna an nei chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi bawk. Governor chuan Grape chauh nilo thei dang sawr leh um theihte pawh ngaihvena huang zauh a tul thu a sawi a. An hmalak lehzelna turah duhsakna a hlan a, Mizoram mai nilo India rama loneitute tana entawntlak leh tihhmuhtu nih tum turin a chah a ni. Environment, Forest & Climate Change Minister Pu T.J. Lalnuntluanga chuan Champhai District chhunga loneitute hmalakna pawimawh tak grape sawngbawlna hmunhma Governor-in a hun hlu tak senga a tlawh chu lawmawm a ti a. Hun harsa tak paltlanga dan anga grape zawrhna tur dan thar Sawrkarin a siam thu sawiin, grape chingtuten hmabak eng tak an neih thu sawiin duhsakna a hlan a. Tun aia nasa zawka hma la a, ram ngaw humhalh nan kum tina lovah thin bansana lo nghet nei thei tura ngaihtuahna seng turin a chah a. Tun atanga reiloteah Sapthei sawngbawlna turte pawh buaipui tum anih thu sawiin, harsatna an neihte a hnena thlen hrehlo turin a chah a ni. Inkawmhona hun Packing Hall, Champhai Winery, Tlangsama hman hi Pu HS.Vanlalfakzuala, Chairman, Champhai Grape Growers Society (CGGS) chuan a kaihruai a. Pu Hrilchunglura, General Manager hnen atangin report ngaihthlak a ni a. Hnahlan Grape Growers and Processing Co-operative Society Limited hotute atangin thusawi ngaihthlak a ni bawk. Mizoram hi North East India-a grape thar awm chhun leh India rama grape thar tam 5-na niin, Champhai leh Hnahlan-ah Winery a awm a. CGGS enkawl Champhai Winery hian kum 14 hmel a hmu tawh a, an Grape sawngbawl hi Bangalore Blue variety niin, vawiin thlengin Grape quintal ,15,218 an lei tling tawh a, hemi atan hian Rs 5,78,41,160/- (cheng vaibelchhe nga maktaduai sarih nuai riat singli sangkhat za leh sawmruk) an seng tawh a ni. Kum 2010 atang khan Grape quintal 918 leiin bul an tan a, kum kalta khan quintal 1144.98 an lei tling a, an Grape lakte hi herin a umna zemah an um mek a ni. Kum 2007 khan Champhai Grape Growers Association (CGGA) tih thin chu Winery din anih dawn avangin Champhai Grape Growers Society (CGGS) ti a thlak niin, Firms & Society-ah an inziahlut a ni. MIP sum cheng nuai 83 (loan) hmanga bultan niin, he loan hi November ni 9, 2020 khan Sawrkar chuan rulh let ngai lo turin grant-ah a leh sak a ni. Champhai Grape Growers Society-ah hian Governing Board Member 15 awmin kum 2 danah inthlan thin a ni a. Tun dinhmunah hian Champhai Grape Growers Society-ah hian Grape chingtu member 134 awm mekin, Staff leh Worker mi 30, Executive Member 9 leh Office Bearer 6 an awm mek bawk a. Champhai Grape Growers Society hnuaiah hian Branch 9 awm mekin mumal taka inenkawlna kalpui thin a ni. CGGS hian Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MOFPI) kaltlangin project an kalpui mek a. DC Office kaltlangin Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK) hnuaiah Commerce & Industries Department hnuaiah project dil mek a ni bawk a. Dan thar hnuaiah Winery License an nei fel tawh a, State pawn thlenga hralhchhuak thei turin hmachhawp an nei a ni. Champhai Winery a tlawh zawh hian Governor chuan BPL family-te tana a thlawna eirawngbawlna gas connection pekna scheme, Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) kaltlanga hamthatna dawngtu leh khawpuia cheng insak tanpuina scheme, Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Housing for All (Urban) dawngtu Tlangsam ami te a tlawh a; scheme awmzia leh tangkainate a sawifiah a, an hmuh dan leh chhawr tangkai dante a zawt nghal bawk. en: STATE LEVEL TASK FORCE HELDS ITS 5th MEETING Shri Zasanga, IPS(Rtd) Chairman, State Level Task Force (SLTF) on National Railways Project, presided over the 5th SLTFâ€™s meeting held at I&PR Conference Hall at 11 AM today. The Task Force deliberated upon; Land Acquisition, Forest Clearance, Construction of Railway station at Sihhmui and Proposal Khanrek Railway Station. Shri V.P. Srivastava, Chief Engineer,NF Railway informed Task Force Members Present, while giving Report On Projects, that Works on Final Location Surveys(FLS) is in progress and GPS, Traversing, Topography Survey was completed for the entire length between Bairabi and Sairang (51.212Kms). Final Stacking was started on 17th April, 2010 from two villages Bairabi and Hortoki, and slated to complete by 31st May, 2010, he added. The meeting decided to send Joint Survey Team,comprising Representatnives of 3 Depts Viz: Revenue, Forest and Railway to witness, inspect and acquire first hand information in regards of the works completed so far by NF Railways and the feasibility of application of the Provision of Land Acquisition and Forest Clearance,on 26th April, 2010 under the guidance of Deputy Commissioner of Kolasib. mz: 5th STATE LEVEL TASK FORCE MEETING. Vawiin chawhma dar 11AM khan I&PR Conference Hall-ah State Level Task Force(SLTF) on National Railway Project Member ten Meeting, Task Force Chairman Pu.Zasanga,IPS(Rtd) kaihruaina hnuaiah an nei. Final Stacking Aligment hi 17th April 2010, khan Bairabi leh Hortoki atanga tan ni tawhin 31st May, 2010. hma a zawh tum a nih thu a sawi bawk. en: PU LAWMAWMA TOCHHAWNG VICE CHAIRMAN HPC INAUGURATES RENOVATED LUNGLEI POLICE STATION BUILDING 151/2023-2024 Lunglei;the 1st August,2023 : Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Vice Chairman, HPC Lunglei inaugurated a newly renovated Lunglei Police Station Building(Ground Floor) here in Lunglei town, today. Lunglei PS building was constructed wayback in 1991 and the building became dilapidated and worn out.Lunglei PS building is a two storey building. Lunglei High Powered Committee Funded this renovation works, at the tune of Rs.15 lakh for each storey. Rs.15 lakh was released for the year 202-2023 which was being used for renovation of Ground Floor, which was inaugurated today. Fund for 1st Floor renovation is also released for the year 2023-2024 and renovation works will be carried out by Police dept, at their earliest. In his augural speech Pu Lawmawma highlighted that Lunglei PS managed to bag the Best Police Station of India Award during 2022-2023.It is quite befitting that the building is also renovated to become the best PS building in Mizoram. He applauded the renovation works executed by PS staff with their all out efforts and with a spirit of love and ownership to get the best result. He exhorted them, since they could manage to bag the Best PS Award too, to try for the Best in traffic management in the whole India. He implored PS staff to be friendly and polite all the time, so that the public will not have any hesitation and fear in approaching the Police station in their time of troubles and distresses. Pu H.Ramthlengliana,IPS,DIG(SR) and Pi Ramdinliani IAS, DC delivered speeches in this function as well. Pu H.Ramthlengliana,IPS,DIG(SR) informed the gathering public how HPC had helped police dept. time and again since many past years and said that renovation works was just one amongst many. He entreated and reminded the police dept. to pay back many blessings they had received from various quarters by rendering their best services to the society. Pi Ramdinliani IAS, DC Lunglei heartily congratulated PS staff for their newly renovated building and applauded them for their dedication and hard work put forth in their renovation works and added that it was worth emulating for other depts. Todayâ€™s brief inaugural function was presided over Pu K.Beihmotaosa MPS,Addl.SP Lunglei and Pu Rahool Alwal IPS, SP Lunglei delivered welcome speech,and technical report was given by Pu L.P Zohmangaiha,OC Lunglei PS.
