mz: PU LAWMAWMA TOCHHAWNG VICE CHAIRMAN HPC IN RENOVATED LUNGLEI POLICE STATION BUILDING A HAWNG 1328/2023-2025 Lunglei;the 1st August,2023 : Vawiin chawhma dar 11:30Am khan Lunglei Police Station Building(Ground Floor) thawmthat chu khuallian Pu Lawmawma Tochhawng, Vice Chairman, HPC Lunglei in a hawng. Building thawmthatna sum hi Lunglei High Powered Committee Fund atanga dawn a ni a. Ground floor leh 1st Floor renovate nan hian Rs.15 lakh ve ve HPC Fund atangin sanction a ni a. Kum 2022-2023 a fund in vawiina hawn tak Ground floor hi siam a ni a. 1st Floor renovate na tur pawh 2023-2024 atan Rs.15 lakh sanction tawh niin, Police Department ten thawmthat hna an thawh theih ve leh hna hi thawh tan theih reng a ni. Lunglei police station building hi kum 1991 a sak tawh kha a ni a, Lunglei khawpui hmun lun lai taka awm a ni a, a building hi a hlui tawh hle a ni. Vawiin renovated Police Station Building hawnna inkhawmah thu sawiin, Pu Lawmawma chuan Lunglei Police station hi India ram pumah Best Police station nihna chelh mektu a ni a,tehna hrang hrang hmanga teh a ni hnuah India ram pumpuia tha ber nihna hauh thei police station in, Mizoram a Police station building tha ber ni tura renovate a han ni hi anihna (best) nen pawh a inhmeh hle a ni. Police te ka lawmpui rualin kei pawhin ka thil hriat ve reng tur tling a ni, a ti. Pu Lawmawma chuan Lunglei Police station staff ten neitu rilru pu a an building thawmthat hna an thawk chu ropui a ti thu sawiin, fak phu te nena hnatawh ho chu a nuam hle a ni, a ti bawk. Khuallian chuan Lunglei Police te chu an hna huamchhung traffic management bikah India ram puma tha ber nihna chelhtu nih tum leh turin a chah a. Police station chu mipui ten tlangnel taka an pan ngam a, an harsatna leh manganna te an thlen ngamna hmun a nih theih nan, kan building thar nena inchawihin, PS staff te pawhin tunaia hawihawm leh nelawma anmahni pantu te,hlim taka an lo chhawn zel theih nan duhsakna a hlan bawk a ni. Vawiin renovated buiding hawnna inkhawm hi police station kawtah neih a ni a, inkhawm hi Pu K.Beihmotaosa MPS,Addl.SP Lunglei in kaihruaiin, Pu H.Ramthlengliana,IPS,DIG(SR) leh Pi Ramdinliani IAS, DC ten thusawina hun an hmang. Pu H.Ramthlengliana,IPS,DIG(SR) chuan HPC in Police Dept. kawng hrang hranga an lo tanpui tawh dawn te tarlangin, Police te pawhin tun aia tha zawk leh taima zawka mipui leh ram tan kan thawh hi kan chunga thiltha tihtute kan rulh let vena a ni, tih i hre tlat ang u, a ti. Pi Ramdinliani IAS, District bawrhsap pawhin Police te a lawmpui zia thu sawiin, hetianga PS building tha hi Mizoramah ka la hmu lo a,ka mithlaah cham reng dawn a ni. Renovation works thawktu Police station staff te inpekna hi dept. dang tan pawâ€™n entawn tlak a ni,a ti. Vawiin renovated building hawnna inkhawmah hian Pu HC.Saihnuna Sailo in hunserh a hmang a. Pu Rahool Alwal IPS, SP Lunglei in welcome speech sawiin, Pu L.P Zohmanmgaiha,OC Lunglei PS in technical report a pe bawk. Attachment Loading attachment...

en: NABARD CELEBRATES INTERNATIONAL WOMENâ€™S DAY 2024 - EXHIBITION STALLS INAUGURATED TO MARK THE OCCASION 373/2023-2024 Aizawl the 8th March, 2024 : Under the aegis of NABARD, Mizoram Regional Office, Aizawl, International Womenâ€™s Day 2024 Celebration Programme was held at HYVE City Hall, Aizawl on 08 March 2024 at 11:30 AM with the Theme â€˜Count Her In: Accelerating gender Equality through Economic Empowermentâ€™. The Function was graced by Pi H Lalchhandami, CEO, MzSRLM, Pi Lalrohlupuii, SMS, Home Science KVK, Aizawl, Pi Lalhlupuii Ralte, Proprietor, Zo Bio Hub, Pu KVSSLV Prasada Rao, General Manager/ OIC, NABARD, Mizoram, T Khup Guite, Deputy General Manager, NABARD. Women SHG Members, successful Women Entreprepeurs participated in the celebration. Pu KVSSLV Prasada Rao, General Manager/ OIC, NABARD welcomed the guests and delivered a key note address highlighting the purpose of organising IWD 2024 function. He highlighted Women are at the centre of various developmental and promotional interventions supported by NABARD such as Skill Development, Tribal Development, Micro Enterprise Development for SHGs in the State of Mizoram. He also highlighted the role played by women in the societal and economic development of the State. Pi Lalhpuluii Ralte, Proprietor, Zo Bio Hub who is a successful woman entrepreneur shared her experience of managing a start-up firm benefitting farmers with market linkages. Zo Bio Hub is a startup that aims to preserve the biodiversity and encourages farmers to grow native aromatic and medicinal plants. Pi Lalrohlupuii who is an expert in Home Science in KVK-Aizawl spoke on the role of KVKs in the country in general and the state of Mizoram in particular. She informed that KVK impart training and technological knowledge to the farmers and rural youth in the state. She stressed for the need of proper nutritional diet, negative effect of having excess sugar and salt in human body, feeding children with proper nutrition and the role of Women SHGs in women empowerment. Pi H Lalchhandami, CEO, MzSRLM graced the function as Chief Guest delivered a talk on the role of Rural Livelihood Mission in the State for womenâ€™s economic empowerment. She thanked NABARD for the support and collaboration extended to MzSRLM in this endeavour. She highlighted the role played by Women SHGs, SHGs federations or Village Organisations (VOs) for their women members. For taking up enterprise activities by women members of SHGs, Community Investment Fund (CIF) and Credit Linkages Banks played a great role in the process. She also highlighted success stories of SHGs and Women Entrepreneur under the Rural Livelihood Mission. On the occasion, two Day exhibition of producsts by SHGs/FPOs/Women Entepreneurs was inaugurated by Pi H Lalchhandami, CEO, MzSRLM. Attachment Loading attachment...

en: SIAHA DC CONDUCTS SURPRISED VISITS TO SOME OFFICES Deputy Commissioner, Siaha District, Pu Bhupesh Chaudhary IAS, conducted a surprised visit to some of the Offices, here at Siaha, today. Pu Bhupesh said that he conducted a surprised visits not to find faults, but to know better the set-up and working-nature of each and every office under his jurisdiction, to listen to them and aware of their problems, and most of all;to remind them of the staff that dereliction of duties will be viewed seriously and DC will keep vigil over them all the time. Some of the offices visited, today were Industrial Training Institute, Excise &Narcotics Office, Mizofed, Printing & Stationery Depot, FCS&Consumer Affairs' Godown. Surprised visits will be conducted randomly to all the offices and institutions under GoM , at Siaha District. In his surprised visits,DC was accompanied by Pu Amol Srivastava IAS, Asst.Commissioner, Pu H.Zonunmawia, Election Officer and Pu N.Vabeiratlua,DIPRO. Attachment Loading attachment...
mz: SIAHA DC IN OFFICE THENKHAT A TLAWH THUT Deputy Commissioner, Siaha District, Pu Bhupesh Chaudhary IAS, chuan vawiin chawhma khan office thenkhat a tlawh thut hlawm a ni. Pu Bhupesh chu a hetianga "surprised visit" ka neih hi, office te hnahawh dan dik lo hailana, tihmualpho emawh hi ka tum a ni lo va, Office hrang hrang te inrelbawl dan te hriata, harsatna an neih te ngaihthlak sak a ni. chuti rual chuan DC hian a awpna hnuaia office hrang hrang te hnathawh dan leh kalphung te hi ngaihven rengin, duty ngaihthah leh awmtha duh lo staff te lakah chuan a thikthu a chhe hle dawn a ni; tih hi hria se ka duh a ni, a ti. Vawiin office a tlawh te hi: ITI(Industrial Training Institute), Excise &Narcotics Office, Mizofed, Printing & Stationery Depot, FCS&Consumer Affairs' Godown te an ni a. Surprised visit hi hun remchang a pianga neih thin a, GoM hnuaia office leh zirna in te chu tlawh chhuah vek tum a ni. Vawiin DC in Surprised visit a neihna-ah hian Pu Amol Srivastava IAS, Asst.Commissioner, Pu H.Zonunmawia, Election Officer leh Pu N.Vabeiratlua,DIPRO ten an tawiawm a ni. en: Mizoram Governor felicitates the first-rank holders of MBSE Class 10 & 12 Examination 71/2024-2025 Aizawl, the 27th May, 2024: Governor Dr. Hari Babu Kambhampati felicitated the first-rank holders of the High School Leaving Certificate and Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate Examination 2024 at the Raj Bhavan, today. The topper from HSLC and three toppers from arts, commerce and science stream of HSSLC received Cash Incentives and Citations from the Governor. G overnor Dr. Hari Babu Kambhampati had an interactive session with each student and asked them about their career plans. He congratulated and conveyed his best wishes to the students and encouraged them to continue performing to the best of their abilities to secure greater success for their future career and endeavours. As per the results of the HSLC Exam and HSSLC Exam 2024 published by the Mizoram Board of School Education (MBSE) recently, Lalmoipuia Lawmzual s/o H.L. Lawmzuala, St. Paul's Higher Secondary School, Aizawl secured the First Rank in the High School Leaving Certificate Examination, 2024. Lalramdina Ralte s/o Lalthakima, St. Paul's Higher Secondary School, Aizawl is the topper in Science stream. David Lalhminghlua s/o Paul Zakhuma, St. Paul's Higher Secondary School, Aizawl is the topper in Commerce stream and Linden Lalremruatpuia s/o C. Lalrindika, Oikos Higher Secondary School, Aizawl is the topper in Arts stream, in the results of the Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate Examinations, 2024. Attachment Loading attachment...
mz: Governor in MBSE Class 10 & 12 Exam Topper-te Raj Bhavan-ah a chawimawi 566/2024-2025 Aizawl the 27th May, 2024: Vawiin khan Governor Dr. Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan High School Leaving Certificate leh Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate Examination 2024-a pakhatnate leh an nu leh pate chu Raj Bhavan a lengah a sawm a. He hunah hian Governor chuan HSLC-a pakhatna leh HSSLC arts, commerce leh science stream-a pakhatnate hnenah chawimawina thuziak leh lawmpuina sum fai a hlan a ni. Governor Dr. Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan zirlai titha te hi a mal te tein a kawm a. Lehkha zir chhunzawm an tum dante zawtin, hna leh eizawnna chungchangte a sawipui a ni. Governor chuan zirlai tithazual te chu a lawmpui tih a sawi a, an thiamnate chu an hmalam huna hna tha tak leh eizawnna ngelnghet tak an neih theih nana hmang turin a fuih bawk a ni. Mizoram Board of School Education (MBSE) in a tarlan angin Lalmoipuia Lawmzual s/o H.L Lawmzuala, St. Paul's Higher Secondary School, Aizawl chu High School Leaving Certificate Examination (HSLC) 2024-ah pakhatna a ni. Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate Examinations (HSSLC) 2024-ah hian Lalramdina Ralte s/o Lalthakima, St. Paul's Higher Secondary School chu Science stream-ah pakhatna a ni a, Commerce stream-ah David Lalhminghlua s/o Paul Zakhuma, St. Paul's Higher Secondary School, Aizawl chu pakhatna niin, Arts stream-a pakhatna chu Linden Lalremruatpuia s/o C. en: DISTRICT TASK FORCE COMMITTEE HELD EMERGENCY MEETING ON COVID-19 AT SIAHA District Task Force,Siaha mulled over how to take preventive measures against Covid-19 pandemic in the emergency meeting held, here at Siaha. District Magistrate had already issued prohibitory order on last Friday(7/3/2020), the order prohibited Cross- border movement between Myanmar and India through passages/roads that linked Myanmar and 10 villages within Siaha district namely: : Lopu, Chapi, Khaikhy, Zyhno,Lodaw, Lomasu, Iana, Siasi, Laki and Khopai village. The Same order highlighted that Check points will be set up at 3 villages namely: Kaochao, Tlapi and Tipi Ferry which located at Inter District Border. In pursuant to the said prohibitory Order, Siaha BDO and Tipa BDO have left for those 10 villages to call for GramSabha meeting and to sensitize about Covid-19 and Prohibitory Order. Today's meeting resolved that villagers of those 10 villages be requested to form a joint committee comprising of Church, NGOs and Village council to vigil over border passage/road that linked their respective village and Myanmar.The meeting also resolved that MADC Forest Guard and India Army stationed at villages located India-Myanmar Border be requested to help proposed village's Joint committee in their vigilant works on Border road/passage. Today's meeting also decided that on the 13th&14th March,2020 a Team comprising Medical officials, Leaders of NGOs, Joint VC members, Police personnel and DC office staff will visited those 13 villages and witness preventive measures taken by each village and carry out sensitization campaign as well. CMO & DMS informed the meeting that there was only one Thermal Infra Red Sensor and 15 Personal Protection Equipments (PPE) presently at Siaha; and 2 TIRS will arrive shortly. TIRS and Self Reporting Format will be placed at check points; and by using TIRS leh Self reporting format; suspected Covid-19 infected travellers will be identified and quarantine for 20 days. Tarik ni 7/3/2020 ah khan District Magistrate chuan Siaha district a khaw 10: Lopu, Chapi, Khaikhy, Zyhno,Lodaw, Lomasu, Iana, Siasi, Laki leh khopai khua te leh Myanmar inkalpawhna kawng a lo khar tawh a. He mi bakah hian Inter district Border crossing point a khaw 3: Kaochao,Tipi Ferry leh Tlapi-ah te Check post siamna tur order a lo chhuah tawh a ni. Heng khaw 13-ah te hian Gram Sabha ko-a Sentisization campaign neih turin Siaha BDO leh Tipa BDO te pawh vawiin lamah an feh chhuak tawh bawk a ni. Vawiin meeting chuan heng khaw 13 -ah te hian Kohhran,NGO leh VC te joint Committee din theuh tura ngen relin, heng Joint Committee te hian an khua nena Myanmar inkalpawhna kawng/khan te chu vil theuh tura ngen a rel bawk. An mahni puibawm turin MADC Forest dept leh Border Area khuaa India sipai awmte pawh sawm an rel bawk. Heng khaw 13-ah te hi tarik ni 13 leh 14 March,2020 khian Medical, NGO hruaitute, Joint VC hruaitute, Police leh DC office joint team te chuan tlawhin, Covid-19 laka inven nana heng khaw 13 ten Myanmar nena inkalpawhna kawng an vil dan te enpuiin, Sentisization campaign an neih zui nghal dawn a ni. en: What then is the way to possess the good land? It is not so simple. Let us enumerate and review the steps. First of all, we must enjoy Christ as the redeeming lamb. We must receive Christ as our Savior. We must pass the judgment of God. This is the first step. If we have done this, we can put a check here; the first item has been passed. What is the second step? We must leave Egypt and enjoy Christ as our daily manna, as our daily life-supply. Of course, we cannot take food without drinking water; so at the same time we must enjoy Christ as the rock with the living water flowing forth. We enjoy the manna and we enjoy the rock with the living water. Do you have such an experience day by day? Many of you can boldly say that you do. Every day you enjoy Christ as your food and as your drink. Otherwise, you could not live, you could not go on, you could not maintain your life as a Christian. Day by day, we must enjoy Christ as our daily food and our living water; we must have something to eat and something to drink. Whenever we meet in the morning, instead of greeting one another with “Good morning!” let us ask “Have you eaten?” I do prefer such a greeting. Have you eaten this morning, brother? Have you drunk something this morning, sister? Some of you can answer that you have had three good meals today. Praise the Lord! We must tell people that day by day we are feeding on Christ. We are eating Christ and we are drinking Christ. If we have this experience, we can check this also.

Hei hi rahbi hmasa ber chu a ni. Hei hi kan ti zo tawh anih chuan, hetah hian enfiahna ka dah thei; thil hmasa ber chu zawh a ni tawh. A rahbi pahnihna chu enge ni? en: CHAMPHAI DISTRICT CONSULTATIVE COMMITTEE (DCC) & DISTRICT LEVEL REVIEW COMMITTEE (DLRC) No.517/2020-2021 Champhai District Consultative Committee (DCC) & District Level Review Committee (DLRC) under the Chairmanship of Pi Maria C.T. Zuali, Deputy Commissioner Champhai held meeting today at DCâ€™s Conference Hall, the Chairman launched the Potential Credit Linked Plan (PLP) 2021-2022 for Champhai District. Chairman urged the Bankers to conduct massive and wider public awareness campaign on facilities provided through Banks. Also the Deputy Commissioner reiterated the urgency of making application forms more simplified instead of intricated forms to facilitate ease of doing business. Pu L.Lawmvela, Lead District Manager (LDM), SBI Lead Bank Office delivered welcome speech followed by discussion on the performances of Bankers and Stakeholders for the quarter ended September, 2020. According to the reporting period, Credit-Deposit (CD) ratio was 44.71 %, against the norm of 60%. Achievement under Priority Sector was 38.42 % while it was 73.43% under Non Priority Sector. Under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) there were 34 beneficiaries (Sishu-20, Kishore-98, Tarun-12, Stand Up India-4) getting loan amounting rupess 200.49 lakhs. Target achievement under Government Sponsored Schemes were also discussed at length. Forty two Bakijai Cases amounting rupees 21.61 lakhs have been reported, and no recovery is reported during the quarter. Non Performing Asset (NPA) under Priority Sector was rupees 1217.20 lakhs (7.07%) while the same in Non Priority Sector was rupees 86.40 lakhs (2.25%). Annual Credit Plan Target for Financial Year 2021-2022 and PMEGP Annual Credit Plan Target were also discussed and approved at the meeting. Also Social Security Schemes, Currency remittance, Bank security, Calendar for DCC meeting and timely submission of DCC data were also discussed among other issues. As of now, there are 15 different Banks branches operating in the district; 4 Public Sector Banks, 4 Private Sector Banks, 6 Regional Rural Banks and 1 State Cooperative Bank. There are a total of 9 ATMs, 8 Business Correspondents, 1 CSP, 26 IPPB Banking Touch Points and 2 Financial Literacy Centres (Lead Bank Office, SBI Sponsored and Champhai Financial Literacy Centre, MCAB Ltd.) in the district. en: Then what will be the ultimate issue? Simply this—on the one hand, there will be the New Jerusalem, and on the other, the lake of fire. The New Jerusalem is the Triune God mingled together with the resurrected man, and the lake of fire is Satan’s ultimate destruction. The lake of fire is the place for Satan. All that is not related to the Triune God and the resurrected man will be put into the lake of fire with Satan. There will be only one tree in the New Jerusalem—the tree of life. The other tree will be in the lake of fire. This is the ultimate conclusion of the whole Scripture. The Scriptures began with three parties, but the ultimate consummation will be the New Jerusalem with only the first tree at the center of the city and the resurrected man as the expression of the Triune God. The second tree will be cast into the lake of fire. All things and all people related to the second tree will have the same destiny as Satan—in that lake of fire.

en: Meghalaya State Planning Board Chairman calls on Chief Minister No.252/2021-2022 Aizawl the 18th August, 2021: Chief Minister Pu Zoramthanga, Chairman of State Planning Board was called on by State Planning Board Chairman Pu Lambor Malngiang (MLA/MDC), Meghalaya today at the formerâ€™s office where they discussed important issues relating to economic development for both states. The Meghalaya State Planning Board Chairman expressed his gratitude for the outstanding hospitality shown by Mizoram and hoped that the bond between the two states would continue to flourish. Speaking of how he works closely with Mizo community and many sub-tribes of Mizoram in his constituency, he expressed his optimism for an enduring friendship and partnership in all sectors. Mizoram Chief Minister echoed the importance of nurturing good relations between the two states, and said that should any situation arise where Mizoram can assist Meghalaya in the development of its economy, Mizoram shall do its best. After his meeting with the Chief Minister, Pu Lambor Malngiang met with Mizoram Planning Board Vice Chairman Pu H. Rammawi followed by a meeting with NGO leaders of the state. He was accompanied by Dr. Krishna Chauhan, Expert Member (Economist) Meghalaya State Planning Board and Pu Enrich GL Nongbri, Law Department, Govt. of Meghalaya. Attachment Loading attachment...
mz: MIZORAM LEH MEGHALAYA PLANNING BOARD HOTUTE INKAWM No.1907/2021-2022 Aizawl, 18th August, 2021: Ni khat cham tura Aizawla lo zin, Pu Lambor Malngiang, Meghalaya State Planning Board Chairman leh Mizoram State Planning Board Vice Chairman Pu H.Rammawi te chu vawiin khan Pu Rammawi office ah inkawmin hma lam hun atana state pahnihte thawh dunna tur chungchang te an sawi dun a ni. Pu H.Rammawi chuan Mizoram State Planning Board kalphung tlangpui te sawifiahin Hmarchhak State te inpumkhatna atan Mizoram leh Meghalaya in thawh dunna tha tak an nei chu lawmawm a tih thu Pu Lambor hnenah hian a sawi a ni. en:
THE PRIESTHOOD WITH THE URIM
AND THE THUMMIM
The second governing principle is the priesthood under
the anointing with the urim and the thummim. What is the
priesthood? This is a wonderful and glorious matter. The
priesthood includes fellowship with the Lord and life and
service in His presence. The priesthood is a group of people
who are inconstant fellowship with the Lord. They continu-
ally commune with the Lord and serve in His presence.
They live, walk, and do everything in this way. When
we have fellowship with the Lord, when we commune with
the Lord day by day and moment by moment, and when in
this living fellowship we live, we serve, and we act, we are a
priesthood.

en: Governor Hari Babu and ITCA member discuss opportunities for students to learn space technology 102/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 28th June 2022: Dr SK Prasad, founder member and advisory council member, Indian Technology Congress Association ( ITCA) had called on Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati at the Raj Bhavan this forenoon. In this meeting, he and Governor discussed the opportunities for the students of higher secondary school, college and university in Mizoram to learn space technology. As proposed by his eminent guest, Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati welcomed the idea of selecting students with a scientific temper to have a preliminary introduction to space science with the option to continue the advanced study depending on their performance in studies. In this regard, he advised Dr SK Prasad and the institutions he represented to have close coordination with the authorities of Higher & Technical Education Department, Mizoram University, NIT Mizoram, Polytechnics, Science & Technology Department and Science Teachers Association Of Mizoram. Dr SK Prasad apprised the Governor of their initiatives in teaching the teams of students and assigning them important science projects like making mini satellites and other space technology. He explained the importance given to horning entrepreneurship skills of the students selected in this model of learning. He told Governor that his purpose of visiting is identifying the institutions with whom they will have a series of correspondences to initiate enrollment of the students in the program. mz: Governor Hari Babu leh ITCA hotupa in Mizorama zirlai thiam zual te tana space technology zir theih dan sawi dun 1070/2022-2023 Aizawl, the 28th June 2022: Vawiin chawhma khan Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati leh Dr SK Prasad, founder member and advisory council member, Indian Technology Congress Association ( ITCA), Bangalore te chu Raj Bhavan-ah an inkawm a. He hunah hian Mizorama zirlai thiam filawr te zinga space technology zir duh thlan chhuah dan tur leh an zir theih dan tur te an sawi dun a ni. Governor Hari Babu Kambhampati chuan Mizorama zirlaite chu lehkha thiam thei tak leh hmundanga zirlaite el phaka thluak tha an ni tih a sawi a. Space technology pawh a zirna kawng a inhawn phawt chuan hlawhtling takin an zir thei turah angai tih a sawi a ni. Governor chuan Dr SK Prasad leh a thawhna hmuna thuneituten Mizoramah zirlai te tan Space Technology zir theihna hun remchang an rawn zawn sak chu lawmawm a tih thu a sawi a. Hemi kawngah hian ITCA hotute chuan Higher & Technical Education Department, Mizoram University, NIT Mizoram, Polytechnics, Science & Technology Department leh Science Teachers Association Of Mizoram berawn se. Anni nena indawrna kaltlang hian zirlai thiam thei zual zinga space technology zir duhte thlanchhuah a awlsam a rin thu a sawi a ni. Dr SK Prasad chuan Prime Minister hmathlir angin India thalaite chu space technology lamah thiamna sang zawk nei tur leh India ram chu a hmahruaitu a nih theih nan chher hriam mek an ni a ti a. He hmalakna kal zelah hian zirlai team 75 te chu kumina project 75 thawk zo hman turin Students' Satellites 75 project hnuaiah satellite te chi(mini satellite) siam turin thlan an ni dawn an a ti. He project-ah hian India rama zirlaite zawng zawng an inel dawn a team 75 thlan an ni dawn a ti a. He project-ah hian Mizorama zirlaite tan pawh tel theihna hun a inhawng thei dawn niin a sawi a ni. Dr Prasad chuan a lo kal chhan tak chu Higher Secondary atanga University Degree zirlaite tan Space Technology zirna an kalpui mek chu Mizorama zirlaite rawn hmelhriat tir a ni a ti a. Hemi kawngah hian Governor leh state sawrkar hotute thlawpna a rawn ngen bakah a bikin science lam zirna kaihhnawiha hotute thawhpuiah a rawn sawm tih a sawi bawk a ni. en: CHAMPHAI DISTRICT TASK FORCE ON CORONA VIRUS OUTBREAK HELD MEETING In pursuance of the decision made by Mizoram State Level Task Force on Mitigation of Corona Virus, Champhai District Task Force on Corona Virus was formed recently and held its first meeting at DC Conference Hall, yesterday. The meeting was presided over by Pu SL Naveen, IAS Deputy Commissioner Champhai. Given its strategic location, Champhai district being located nearby International Border, the meeting mentioned the needs for proper medical screening at Zokhawthar and restriction on movement particularly travellers based on their travelling history. To boost up the preventive measures, the meeting highlighted the importance of fostering better coordination with the neighbouring district administration of Myanmar. The meeting decided to organize awareness campaigns for villages nearby border areas and preparation of isolation ward for quarantine in case any suspect is detected. CMO Office was assigned to prepare budget encompassing all requirements for further submission to the higher authority. At the border Town of Zokhawthar, Government of Mizoram has been monitoring the situation and is conducting Medical Screening since the 4th of February 2020 with proper Self Reporting Form. Champhai District Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak Contact Number is given as 8588009756/9436376607.
mz: CHAMPHAI DISTRICT TASK FORCE ON CORONA VIRUS OUTBREAK THUKHAWM Tunlaia China leh khawvel ram dangte ngaihven hlawh tak Novel Coronavirus (2019-nCoV) natna leng mek laka Champhai District lo him leh invenlawkna tura din, District Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak chu a vawikhatna turin vawiin chawhnu khan Bawrhsap Pu SL Naveen, IAS hovin DC Conference Hall-ah an thukhawm. Meeting-ah hian Champhai District chu International Border-a awm anih avangin Novel Coronavirus leng darh zel tur laka fimkhur angaih thu tarlan niin, meeting chuan ramri kaltlanga veivak leh sumdawng thinte chu he natna len mekna hmun leh a chhehvelte laka fimkhur turin a ngen a. He hunah hian mihring veivak leh ran khuahkhirh anih dante ngaihthlak a ni bawk a. Champhai District ep Myanmar ram District-te nena inbiakpawh leh inzaitawn zela hmalak a tul thu pawh tarlan a ni a. District Task Force on Coronavirus Outbreak chuan ramri depa awm khuate chu tlawhchhuaka mipuite hnena zirtirna zau zawk kalpui nise, ramri kaltlanga lutte hriselna endik pahin chhui zui ngai awmte pawh chhuichian ni se a ti a. Champhai District Hospital-a Isolation Ward ruahman ni se tih bakah mamawh tur ang budget-te pawh a rang lama siama thuneitu sang zawk hnena thlen nise tih a ni. District Level Task Force on Corona Virus Outbreak hi Mizoram State Health Minister leh H&FW Department hotute January Ni 30, 2020 a thukhawm in an din tak State Level Task Force on Mitigation of Corona Virus duh dan anga district tina hma lo la tur a din a ni. Champhai District-a Zokhawtharah February Ni 4, 2020 atang khan Medical Screening hi kalpui tan a ni a, khualzinte chinchang zawhfiah leh a tul anga endik hna hi kalpui thin niin, Self Reporting Form mumal tak kalpui tan a ni tawh bawk. en:
As we have listened, there was a Government of India notification on September 
24, 2020, and based on that, all the states followed. But ‘water’ falls under the state list, 
so the state government has the authority. 16 states and 5 UTs currently have a similar
act regarding this, and 11 states are currently discussing this Act. Four states regarded 
it as unnecessary to have this Act, these are Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Sikkim, and 
Tripura. On the other hand, I believe Mizoram urgently requires this Act, but there must 
be a way to control it. Whoever is capable of doing it must not attempt to pump out 
water, as it could disturb the water tables. So, it is good that such acts as these exist. 
Chapter 6, Section 29 (C), talks about penalties for violators.
mz:
Kan ngaihthlak ang khan, September Ni 24, 2020-ah Govt. of India notification 
a awm a, chu mi dungzuiin State tinah buatsaih a ni bawk a. Amaherawhchu, tui hi State 
List a nih angin state tin sorkar chu a thu viau mai a. Tunah hian State 16 leh UT 5-ah 
he Dan hi neih a ni tawh a. Tin, State 11-ah ngaihtuah mek a ni bawk a. State 4 hi chuan 
an ramah he Dan neih hi tul an ti lova, chungte chu - Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, 
Sikkim leh Tripura te an ni. Mizoram-ah erawh chuan a tul ngawih ngawihin ka hria a. 
Amaherawhchu, control a ngai a ni. Tute’n emaw an duh duhna hmunah an pump 
chhuak rikngawt kha chu a him lova, lei hnuaia water table te pawh tibuai thei a ni. 
Chuvangin, hetianga Dan lo awm hi a tha ka ti a. Chapter 6, section 29(C)-ah khan 
hremna Dan a awm a.

en: RASHTRIYA EKTA DIWAS OBSERVES TODAY Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (National Unity Day) was observed today at AR Ground, Aizawl. Deputy Chief Minister Shri Tawnluia graced the event as Chief Guest. Chief Secretary Shri Lalnunmawia Chuaungo administered the Rashtriya Ekta Diwas Pledge taking ceremony. Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (National Unity Day) celebration started early in the morning with a â€˜Unity Runâ€™ from Sikulpuikawn and Chanmari, flagged off by the Commissioner and Secretaries of School Education and Higher & Technical Departments respectively. About 500 students participated in this run to permeate national unity. Nine Contingents participated in the March Past, Assam Riffles Band Party performed the National Anthem. mz: RASHTRIYA EKTA DIWAS ROPUI TAKA HMAN A NI Vawiin zing khan AR Ground-ah Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (National Unity Day) hman a ni a, Deputy Chief Minister Pu Tawnluia chu khuallian a ni. Khuallian Pu Tawnluia chuan thu sawiin, India hnam inpumkhatna atana hma nasa taka la tu Sardar Valabhai Patel piancham denchhenin October Ni 31 chu Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (Hnam Inpumkhatna Ni)-ah India sawrkar chuan a puang a ni, a ti a. Deputy Chief Minister chuan Kum 2014 atangin Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (National Unity Day) hman tan a ni a, vawiin hi vawi ruk hmanna a ni, tiin a sawi a. Kum 1917-ah Sardar Valabhai Patel chuan India Hnam Pa Mahatma Gandhi thusawi a ngaihthlak a tangin India hnam tan theih tawp a chhuah a, huaisen taka thawk mi, â€˜Iron Man of Indiaâ€™ ti hiala koh thin a ni, a ti a. British in India a chhuahsan dawn khan India lal ram hrang hrang 500 chuang India chunga an awm khawm theih nan hma a la a ni a ti a. Khuallian Pu Tawnluia chuan India zalenna sual chhuaktute zinga mi pawimawh Sardar Valabhai Patel ang hian hnam tana thawk turin leh inpumkhatna vawng nung zel turin kalkhawmte a sawm a ni. Chief Secretary Pu Lalnunmawia Chuaungo chuan hemi hun hmang tura kal zawng zawng hnenah Rashtriya Ekta Diwas thutiam a chham tir a. Contingent 9- Assam Riffles, BSF, 1st Battalion MAP, 3rd Battalion MAP, 5th IR Battalion, Home Guard, 225 Battalion CRPF, One Mizo Air Squadron NCC, 20 Mizo Independent Company NCC te parade in, Parade Commander hi Inspector PC Vanlalsawma, MAP a ni a, Assam Riffles Band Party ten National Anthem an tum bawk a ni. Rashtriya Ekta Diwas lawmna a tan hian zing Dar 7-ah sikul naupang 500 ten Sikulpuikawn leh Chanmari atangin Run for Unity neiin, AR Ground-ah an in tawk khawm a ni. Attachment Loading attachment...

en: MIZORAM POLICE PRESS STATEMENT 67/2023-2024 PUBLIC ADVISORY ON DIGITAL PAYMENT FRAUD With the increasing use of Digital Payment Systems, Mizoram has also witnessed a sharp increase in digital payment frauds. Cyber fraudsters are finding new methods to dupe vulnerable and unsuspecting citizens. Online financial frauds account for more than 75% of all cyber-crimes reported in the State. With an aim to prevent financial losses to the general public through online frauds, Mizoram Police once again appeals to public to take following precautions: 1. Never share your Banking password, OTP (one time password) or Debit/Credit Card details with others. 2. Never scan QR Code, when you are to receive money. It is only required for transferring money to other accounts. 3. Beware of phishing scams trying to steal your Banking or UPI information. Look out for fake emails and websites, that try to collect information and do not click on unknownâ€™unfamiliar links. 4. Always use familiar websites for online shopping rather than shopping by searching products on search engines. Search results can be misleading and may lead to malicious websites. 5. Ignore advertisements/deals, if they claim that you can earn money with little or no work or you can make money on an investment with little or no risk. If an offer seems too good to be true, it is most likely to be a scam. 6. Beware of fake loan apps that provide quick and easy loans. Such illegal apps will seek a variety of information and permissions from applicants, which is then misused to blackmail them later. If using digital loan app, please ensure that it has RBI authorization. 7. Beware of fraudsters, who impersonate as army/police personnel advertising cheap items online. We urge citizens to exercise extreme caution, while conducting financial transactions online. If you are a victim of financial fraud, call Cyber Helpline 1930 or register your complaints on www.cybercrime.gov.in . STEP BY STEP GUIDE ON REGISTRATION OF COMPLAINT AT www.cybercrime.gov.in : 1. Go to the website â€œ www.cybercrime.gov.inâ€ through any mobile or computer browser (Google, Safari, etc.) 2. There will be two red boxes. Select the box titled â€˜File a complaintâ€. 3. Click on the 7 Acceptâ€™ box that comes up. 4. Click on â€˜Report Cyber Crimeâ€™. 5. On the new page that comes up, first click on â€˜Click here for new userâ€™ on the top right and fill up the form. 6. After logging into your account, register your complaint. Select the cybercrime category that pertains to you. 7. If you were duped of money through an online transaction, select â€˜Online Financial Fraudâ€™ 8. Enter details of the bank account from which money was sent. 9. If payment was done through UPI, select the UPI app (BHIM, GPay, Paytm, etc) which you used to send money. 10. Enter the transaction ID of where you sent the money. Note: Transaction IDs are of 12 digits. They can be obtained from your bank statement or your UPI transaction details received through SMS. 11. If your account had been credited without your knowledge, enter the relevant details on â€˜Credit Transaction detailsâ€™. 12. After having entered all details as required, select â€˜Save as draft and Nextâ€™. 13. On the next page, enter details of the fraudster if you are aware. Then click on â€˜Save as draft and Nextâ€™. 14. On the next page, enter the complainant/victimâ€™s details and then click on â€˜Save as draft and Nextâ€™. 15. Lastly, click on â€˜I Agreeâ€™ and then â€˜Confirm and Submitâ€™. After this has been completed, you will receive an SMS with an acknowledgement number through which you will be able to keep track of your case.
mz: MIZORAM POLICE PRESS STATEMENT 566/2023-2024 Mizoram police media cell chuan Digital Payment System chungchanga mipuite hnena thurawn a hnuaia mi ang hian a ti chhuak : DIGITAL PAYMENT INBUMNA CHUNGCHANGA THURAWN : Digital Payment Systems hman kan uar chhoh viau laiin hemi kaihhnawiha inbumna pawh nasa takin Mizoramah ngei pawh a sang chho chak hie a ni. Hetianga internet khawvela bum tur zawng ho hian rinhlelh nachang hre lo leh bum awlsam tur zawngin, inbum dan thar an hmu chhuak reng bawk. Tunah hian Mizorama Cyber Crime case ziah luh zinga 75% aia tarn hi 'online financial fraud' kaihhnawih a ni. Chuvangin hetianga inbumna laka kan himna atan Mizoram Poice chuan a hnuaia tarlan ang hian mipuite a ngen a ni: I banking password, OTP, Debit Card/Credit Card details te tumah hrilh suh. Phishing scammer te hian i Bank leh UPI information pawimawh ruksak che an turn reng tih hria la, email leh website lemah te, link hriat chian lohah te lut mai mai suh ang che. en: MIZORAM PUBLISHED ELECTORAL ROLL, 2010. Directorate of Election, Mizoram on the 20th July, 2010 had notified the publication of the Lists of Ammendments to the Final Electoral Roll, 2010 for each of the 40( Forty) Assembly Contituencies in Mizoram. The Lists of Amendments in the Electoral Rolls, 2010 so notified vide No.H.11011/24/2010-CEO : Dt 20.07.2010 have been published and will be available for inspection at the offices of District Election Officer, Electoral Registration Officer and Assistant Electoral Registration Officer.
